title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Job Type: Full-time



Salary: PHP35,000 - PHP50,000/month, depending on experience



Work Hours: Full-time, hours overlapping Malaysia business hours (GMT+8). No night shift



*About us*



We're a group of four education and workforce brands built around Australian-linked qualifications and job pathways: EDUK8U (flagship professional development brand), ICQA (International College of Queensland Australia, RTO 46584, nationally recognised Australian qualifications), Work Ready Asia (recruitment and job placement), and AttendCare (Australian aged care/disability support employer). We market and sell across Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Fiji, and Australia.



You'll be joining a lean two-person in-house marketing team and taking on hands-on execution across all four brands, so you'll be working across genuinely different campaigns (course enrolment, recruitment, B2B) in the same week, not one brand on repeat.



*What you'll do*



Plan, build, and manage organic and paid campaigns on Meta Ads, Google Ads, Linkedin and TikTok Ads across all EDUk8U / ICQA brand accounts, keeping budgets, audiences, and creative rotation organised separately per brand



Apply working knowledge of the Australian digital advertising landscape, our course outcomes and job placements are Australia-linked, and you need to know what resonates with or is compliant for that context, not just generic APAC ad experience



Use GoHighLevel (GHL) daily as our CRM and funnel platform: build and maintain landing pages, automations, and lead routing across all four brand pipelines



Design ad creative, landing page assets, and social content in Canva, AI



Use AI tools (Claude, Manus, or similar) as a normal part of your workflow, for campaign research, ad copy drafting, and speeding up reporting, we're actively building AI-assisted marketing workflows and want someone who already works this way



Work with our tech team to monitor/run SEO for the group's four brand websites: on-page optimisation, content structure, basic technical fixes, and tracking rankings/organic traffic



Build and run lead generation campaigns, tracking cost per lead and lead quality by channel and by brand, and flag when a channel stops converting



Pull and interpret performance data across ad platforms, GHL, and Google Analytics, report weekly on what's working, what isn't, and where budget should move



Follow compliance-safe advertising practice for ICQA specifically, as an ASQA-regulated RTO, some campaigns need sign-off on claims before they go live, you'll be told which



*What you need*



Minimum 3-5 years of solid hands-on paid media experience actually running Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads campaigns, not just certifications, we'll ask for examples and results



Comfortable managing multiple brand accounts and campaign types at once



Practical understanding of the Australian digital advertising landscape and audience



Direct GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred, this is our core CRM and you'll use it daily from week one



Strong Canva skills / AI enhanced image for ad and social creative



Genuine day-to-day use of AI tools (Claude, Manus, ChatGPT, or similar) in your marketing work already, tell us how you use them



Working SEO knowledge: on-page optimisation, basic technical SEO, content structure



Comfortable reading data and building your own reports, not waiting for someone else to interpret platform dashboards or Google Analytics



Lead generation campaign experience in education, recruitment, or another regulated/considered-purchase sector



Excellent written English, since you'll be drafting ad copy and landing page content



*To Apply*



Share your: 



- Your CV

- Portfolio with Links or screenshots of 2-3 paid campaigns you personally built and ran (Meta, Google, or TikTok), with the result in verified data - we like to see your campaign successes and failures. 

- One sentence on how you currently use AI tools (Claude, Manus, ChatGPT, or similar) in your marketing work

- Your earliest available start date



Applications without your CV, campaign examples, or the AI-tools answer will not be reviewed.

title: Advertising Sales & Business Development Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



Kumabe Media Group is a growing media and publishing company based in Las Vegas, Nevada. We publish Vegas Equity Insider, a premium business, lifestyle, real estate, and community publication featuring entrepreneurs, executives, business leaders, and companies making an impact.



We are expanding and looking for a motivated Advertising Sales & Business Development Specialist who can help us identify potential advertisers, start conversations with decision-makers, and generate new advertising and sponsorship revenue.



This is a sales and business development position. We are not looking for someone who simply completes administrative tasks. We are looking for someone who is comfortable reaching out to businesses, starting conversations, following up consistently, and helping turn prospects into advertising clients.



OnlineJobs.ph specifically supports hiring remote talent for roles including sales representatives, lead generation, telemarketing, and marketing, so the role fits the platform well.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your primary responsibility will be to help generate advertising and sponsorship revenue for Vegas Equity Insider and other Kumabe Media Group properties.



Your responsibilities will include:



Researching and identifying businesses that would be a good fit for our advertising opportunities.

Finding business owners, CEOs, marketing directors, and other decision-makers.

Building targeted prospect lists.

Making outbound calls to businesses.

Sending personalized
s and LinkedIn messages.

Following up consistently with potential advertisers.

Introducing businesses to our magazine, digital media, sponsorship, and advertising opportunities.

Qualifying interested prospects.

Scheduling qualified sales appointments with our team.

Maintaining accurate records of calls,
s, conversations, and follow-up activity.

Helping develop and improve our sales outreach process.

Identifying potential sponsors, strategic partners, and long-term advertising clients.

THIS POSITION IS FOR YOU IF...



You enjoy talking to people and are comfortable making outbound calls.



You are persistent without being pushy.



You understand that sales requires follow-up and that "no response" does not necessarily mean "no."



You can communicate clearly and professionally in English.



You are organized and able to keep track of multiple prospects and follow-up conversations.



You are motivated by results and excited about helping a growing media company generate revenue.



Previous experience in any of the following is a plus:



Advertising sales

Media sales

B2B sales

Appointment setting

Business development

Lead generation

Cold calling

Telemarketing

Sponsorship sales

Digital marketing sales

Real estate sales or lead generation

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS



Because you will be communicating directly with business owners and decision-makers, applicants must have:



Excellent spoken and written English.

A clear, professional speaking voice.

A neutral or easily understandable accent.

Previous experience making outbound calls, sales calls, or appointment-setting calls is strongly preferred.

Reliable high-speed internet.

A quality headset and a quiet workspace.

A reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs and communication tools.

The ability to work during at least some U.S. business hours.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.



You do not need previous experience in the magazine industry. We will provide training on our company, publications, advertising opportunities, ideal clients, and sales messaging.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



This is a results-driven position.



Performance will be measured based on activity and outcomes, including:



Number of businesses researched

Number of decision-makers identified

Outbound calls completed

s and LinkedIn outreach completed

Follow-up activity

Qualified conversations generated

Sales appointments booked

Advertising opportunities generated

Revenue generated from your efforts



We will work with the selected candidate to establish clear daily and weekly goals.



WHAT WE OFFER



We are looking for someone who wants the opportunity to grow with a company—not just complete repetitive tasks.



The right candidate will receive:



Competitive hourly compensation based on experience

Performance-based incentives and/or commission opportunities

Training and sales scripts

The opportunity to work with a U.S.-based media company

The opportunity to grow into a larger sales, business development, or advertising leadership role as the company expands

Long-term work opportunities for the right person

TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



We receive many applications, and attention to detail is important for this position.



To apply, please do the following:



1. Use the exact subject line:



VEI SALES



2. Start your application by answering these three questions:



A. Tell us about your previous experience with sales, cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development.



B. Describe your experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers by phone.



C. What would you say if your job was to help a growing Las Vegas media company find businesses interested in advertising?



3. Include a short voice or video introduction, approximately 60–90 seconds.



Tell us:



Your name

Where you are located

Your sales or calling experience

Why you believe you would be successful in this position



4. At the very end of your application, write this exact phrase:



BUILD THE PIPELINE



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.

Skills & Experience



Essential:

- Strong understanding of product uploads, collections, merchandising and website maintenance

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

- Strong organisational and time-management skills

- Confident working independently in a remote environment

- Proactive approach and willingness to take ownership rather than waiting for instructions

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Reliable, responsive and comfortable working collaboratively with a team



Highly regarded:

- Previous experience with a **fashion, apparel, lifestyle or retail ecommerce brand**

- Experience supporting product launches, promotions and seasonal campaigns

- Experience with ecommerce reporting and inventory coordination

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Understanding of the online customer journey and ecommerce best practices



Cultural Fit

We’re particularly interested in someone who:

- Has a **positive, solutions-focused attitude**

- Is proactive and naturally looks for what needs to be done next

- Takes accountability and follows tasks through to completion

- Communicates openly when there is an issue, delay or uncertainty

- Is comfortable receiving feedback and adapting quickly

- Works well with different personalities and functions

- Is dependable and consistent

- Enjoys working in a fast-paced fashion environment

- Cares about the quality and accuracy of their work



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your **most updated CV**

2. A brief summary of your hands-on **Shopify experience**

Please note:We are specifically looking for candidates with genuine hands-on Shopify experience. General virtual assistant or administrative experience without ecommerce/Shopify exposure will not be sufficient for this position.

title: Part-Time Customer Support Specialist | Premium U.S. Wellness Brand | Remote
description:
Forma Pilates is a premium Pilates and wellness brand with studios across the U.S. and a growing global digital membership platform.



We are looking for an exceptional, highly organized Customer Support Specialist based in the Philippines to become the primary point of contact for our digital customers.



This is not a high volume call center position, and there are no phone calls required. Customer communication is primarily through
 and in-app messaging.



Our priority is not simply answering messages quickly. We want someone who provides thoughtful, polished and responsive customer service that reflects the level of the Forma brand.



The Role



You will take ownership of customer inquiries from beginning to end.



For straightforward questions and account issues, you will resolve them yourself. When an issue requires someone else on our team, you will route it to the appropriate person, follow up internally and remain responsible for making sure the customer ultimately receives a resolution.



The customer should never have to figure out who at Forma is responsible for their issue.



What You’ll Handle



-Monitor and respond to our digital customer service
 inbox

-Monitor and respond to customer messages through Intercom

-Assist customers with subscriptions, billing questions, promotional codes and account issues

-Review customer account activity when necessary to investigate questions

-Help with subscription changes, cancellations and other common account requests

-Use our existing Help Center and knowledge base to resolve common questions

-Escalate genuine technical problems to our development team

-Route fulfillment, marketing or other specialized issues to the appropriate internal team member

-Follow up on escalated issues until they are resolved

-Maintain clear internal notes so nothing falls through the cracks

-Identify recurring customer issues and help us improve our FAQs and internal customer-service playbook



What We’re Looking For



Exceptional written English is essential.



Our customers expect a premium experience. Your writing should be natural, warm, concise and professional. Responses should never feel generic, scripted or like outsourced customer support.



You should have:



-Excellent written English and grammar

-Strong judgment and attention to detail

-Prior experience with
-based customer service

-Excellent follow-through and personal accountability

-A strong sense of ownership- if you escalate an issue internally, you still consider yourself responsible for following it through until the customer receives a resolution

-The ability to investigate and solve a problem rather than simply forward it to someone else

-Experience working with customer accounts, subscriptions or billing

-Comfort learning new software and internal systems

-Reliable high-speed internet

-Reliable availability during agreed U.S. Pacific Time coverage windows

-A polished, friendly and calm communication style



Experience with Stripe, RevenueCat, Intercom, Shopify, mobile apps, subscription businesses or membership businesses is a significant plus, but we can train an exceptional candidate on our specific systems.



Schedule



Approximately 15–20 hours per week, spread across 7 days a week.



Daily availability, including Saturdays and Sundays, is required.



This is not necessarily a continuous 2–3 hour shift each day. The role will involve multiple scheduled customer-service check-ins throughout the day so customers receive timely responses across U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



Some days will be quieter than others. What matters most is consistent coverage, responsiveness and ownership of any open customer issues.



As Forma Online grows, there may be an opportunity for additional hours and responsibility.



Compensation



$5–$6 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



We are not looking for the lowest-cost candidate. We would rather pay more for someone exceptional who can represent our brand well and become a reliable long-term member of the team.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



-A brief introduction and description of your relevant customer-service experience.

-The customer-support platforms and software you have previously used.

-Any experience you have with Stripe, RevenueCat, Intercom, Shopify, mobile apps or subscription-based businesses.

-Your availability in U.S. Pacific Time, including your availability on Saturdays and Sundays.

-Your requested hourly rate.

-Your answer to the customer scenario below.



Customer Service Scenario



A customer writes:



“I signed up for the monthly plan last week, but I just saw your promotion for the annual membership. Can you switch me to annual and apply the promotional price? I don’t want to be charged twice.”



Write the
 you would send back to this customer.



Please write this response entirely in your own words and do not use AI or other writing-assistance tools. We are evaluating your natural written communication, judgment and customer-service approach. Selected candidates will complete additional customer-support scenarios during the interview process.

title: Data Analyst

Farpp, a creative software company in partnership with Nelovy Health Care LTD, is hiring a Data Analyst to turn our growing volume of testing data into meaningful insights. As we expand our operations across seven countries with hundreds of remote testers, we need someone who can make sense of the numbers and help us make smarter, faster decisions.



As a Data Analyst, you will work with raw data from our global testing network — device logs, hardware IDs, bug reports, tester activity, and conversion metrics. Your job is to clean, structure, and analyse this data, then present it in a way that tells a clear story. You will be the person leadership turns to when they ask "what's working, what's not, and what should we do next?"



Responsibilities:



Clean, organise, and maintain datasets from testing operations across multiple countries

Analyse device compatibility data — identify which Windows versions, builds, and hardware configurations cause the most issues

Track tester productivity: active testers, devices tested per person, submission rates, and dropout patterns

Monitor recruitment funnel metrics: applicants per platform, conversion to hire, time to first submission

Build and maintain live dashboards and visual reports (charts, tables, trend lines)

Identify anomalies, outliers, and data quality issues before they become problems

Provide weekly data summaries with key takeaways for leadership

We're looking for a creative editor to turn that raw footage (not AI) into captivating video ads that convert.

Pay and how this starts:

- If it goes well: ongoing at $350 USD/month for 10 hrs/week, paid twice a month. More hours and more pay as volume grows.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Penetration tester

Farpp, a creative software company in partnership with Nelovy Health Care LTD, is hiring System Testers to evaluate how our Windows desktop application interacts with different system environments. While our other testing roles focus on features and user experience, this role goes deeper — you will examine how Farpp behaves at the system level across a variety of hardware and software configurations.



As a System Tester, you will investigate how our application coexists with other software, how it handles system resources, how it responds to different Windows settings, and whether it leaves a clean footprint. Your work ensures that Farpp runs reliably on any Windows machine without conflicts, slowdowns, or unexpected behaviour.



Responsibilities:



Test Farpp's behaviour across different Windows configurations (clean installs, updated systems, older builds)

Monitor CPU, memory, and disk usage while the application is running

Check application behaviour during system events: startup, shutdown, sleep, restart, and user switching

Test compatibility with common antivirus software and firewalls (Windows Defender, Avast, Norton, etc.)

Verify the application installs, runs, and uninstalls cleanly without leaving residual files or registry entries

Test alongside other common applications to identify conflicts (browsers, media players, office suites, games)

Document system tray behaviour: icon visibility, right-click menu, tooltip accuracy, notification handling

Record system specifications (OS version, build number, RAM, processor, disk type) for each test

Report any crashes, freezes, error messages, or abnormal system behaviour with detailed steps to reproduce

Submit structured weekly test reports

title: Part-Time Social Media Reply Assistant
description:
I run a browser extension that scores news articles for how likely the text is AI generated. I need someone to find people sharing news articles on X and Bluesky, check the article with the extension, and post a short, friendly reply about what the tool found.



This job is about judgement and trust more than volume. Every reply is public and represents the tool, so who you choose to reply to matters far more than how many replies you post.



Daily work, around 2/3 hours x 7:

- Find active, recent posts on X,
 and Bluesky where someone is sharing a news article

- Open the article and run the extension, using an account I provide

- Post a short reply saying what the tool found

- Around 10 replies a day

- Report back any reply that gets a positive response, so we can learn what works



Who to reply to:

Only people sharing an article that someone else wrote. Never the journalist who wrote it, never the publisher or outlet account, and never anyone the article is about. Skip anything about death, disaster or similarly grim subjects. Posts must be recent and topical, because old threads get no views.



Both results are worth posting. An article that flags as human written is just as interesting as one that flags as AI, and I want a good share of those. Most articles flag as AI, so finding the human ones takes deliberate searching. That is the harder half of the job.



Tone: curious, never accusatory. Something like "interesting, this one flags strongly as AI on the extension I use" rather than any kind of accusation. Always phrase it as what the tool says, not as fact. Never argue. If someone pushes back, reply once politely and leave it.



Trial: There is a paid trial before any account access. You find 10 to 12 real posts that meet the rules above and send me the post link, the article link, one line on why it qualifies, and your draft reply. If it is not right, I will give you feedback and ask you to redo it. Being able to take a correction and apply it properly is part of what I am testing, so expect two rounds.



What I need from you:

- Excellent written English that reads naturally, not formal or promotional

- Good judgement about when not to post

- Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear rather than guessing

- Reliable daily availability

title: Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT VLARI



VLARI is a specialized U.S.-based advisory firm serving established business owners. We work with a limited number of clients and prioritize quality, accuracy, confidentiality, and thoughtful service over high case volume.



We are seeking a reliable, highly organized Client Case & Business Operations Coordinator for a full-time, long-term position.



This is a versatile role for someone who enjoys managing detailed processes, communicating professionally with clients, organizing financial documents, and ensuring that every case continues moving forward.



This is not a sales, call-center, or independent advisory position. You will receive training in our internal processes. You will begin with client onboarding, administrative support, document organization, and case coordination. As you demonstrate proficiency, your responsibilities may expand into preliminary case preparation and implementation tracking.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Once a client completes payment, you will become the client’s primary operational contact.



You will own the administrative journey from payment through completed onboarding and preparation of a review-ready client file.



You will make sure clients understand what is required, submit the appropriate documents, answer all required intake questions, receive timely updates, and progress through each stage of the engagement.



POST-PAYMENT CLIENT ONBOARDING



Your responsibilities will include:



* Sending welcome communications immediately after payment

* Explaining the onboarding process and next steps

* Providing access to the secure client portal

* Confirming completion of engagement documents and required acknowledgments

* Scheduling onboarding, review, and presentation meetings

* Guiding clients through intake questionnaires

* Asking approved follow-up questions when information is incomplete

* Providing and explaining the required-document checklist

* Collecting tax returns, financial statements, payroll records, entity documents, insurance information, investment statements, and other requested records

* Reviewing documents for completeness, legibility, correct reporting periods, and missing pages

* Comparing submitted documents against the client’s checklist

* Following up professionally for missing information

* Documenting the client’s objectives, concerns, priorities, and unanswered questions

* Entering and verifying information in company systems

* Maintaining accurate notes, tasks, deadlines, and pipeline stages

* Preparing a consolidated internal case summary

* Identifying inconsistencies and questions that require escalation

* Confirming when the client’s file is complete and ready for professional review

* Sending appropriate progress updates throughout the engagement

* Coordinating communication among the client, company leadership, and assigned professionals



CASE AND IMPLEMENTATION COORDINATION



After training, your responsibilities may also include:



* Organizing financial and business information for internal analysis

* Extracting designated information from financial statements and tax documents

* Preparing preliminary internal summaries for review

* Operating internal assessment and case-preparation systems

* Coordinating reviews with accountants, attorneys, insurance professionals, and other specialists

* Recording professional feedback and requested changes

* Preparing meeting briefs and client presentation materials

* Creating and maintaining implementation checklists

* Assigning and tracking approved implementation steps

* Following up with clients and outside professionals

* Assisting with insurance and annuity application processing

* Tracking applications, signatures, transfers, funding, and outstanding requirements

* Communicating with insurance carriers and related organizations

* Maintaining accurate case statuses until completion

* Escalating matters requiring professional judgment or approval



ADMINISTRATIVE AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Because VLARI serves a limited number of quality clients, this position will support several areas of the business. Additional responsibilities may include:



* Managing calendars and appointment confirmations

* Monitoring and organizing company

* Answering and routing administrative client calls

* Drafting routine client communications

* Updating CRM records and pipeline stages

* Organizing company files and folders

* Maintaining standard operating procedures

* Auditing client files for missing information

* Assisting with basic bookkeeping and operational reporting

* Maintaining service and follow-up calendars

* Researching administrative information when assigned

* Testing intake forms, reports, and internal workflows

* Supporting special company projects during lower-volume periods



PROFESSIONAL BOUNDARIES



You will explain company processes, collect factual information, answer approved administrative questions, and coordinate work that has already been authorized.



You will not be expected or authorized to independently:



* Provide U.S. tax advice

* Provide legal advice

* Recommend investments, insurance policies, or annuities

* Approve client strategies

* Promise financial or tax results

* Represent yourself as a U.S.-licensed professional

* Release a final client design without approval



Any question involving professional judgment or a recommendation must be documented and escalated to the appropriate professional.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have an accounting, bookkeeping, business administration, insurance, or financial-services background

* Have experience supporting U.S. clients or companies

* Are comfortable reviewing financial documents

* Communicate clearly and professionally by
, telephone, and video

* Are highly organized and careful with details

* Follow instructions and documented procedures

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Are comfortable performing both analytical and routine administrative work

* Know when to ask questions or escalate an issue

* Enjoy managing cases from beginning to completion

* Want a stable, long-term role with one company

* Respect confidentiality and sensitive client information

* Prefer quality and accuracy over high-volume, rushed work

* Are interested in growing within an organization rather than building a competing advisory practice



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Strong spoken and written English

* At least two years of relevant administrative, bookkeeping, accounting, insurance, client-service, or case-management experience

* Strong spreadsheet,
, and document-management skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Leadership Skills

* Managerial Skills

* Professional telephone presence

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional environment for client calls

* Ability to handle confidential financial information

* Ability to organize multiple cases and deadlines

* Willingness to complete reference and background checks

* Willingness to sign confidentiality, data-security, and intellectual-property agreements

* Availability for scheduled overlap with U.S. Pacific Time



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



* QuickBooks Online

* GoHighLevel or another CRM

* U.S. bookkeeping or accounting

* U.S. business financial statements

* U.S. business tax documents

* Client onboarding

* Life-insurance or annuity case processing

* Financial-advisor support

* Tax Strategies

* Project Manager

* Project Coordinator

* DocuSign or secure client portals

* Workflow and implementation tracking

* Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets



COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



* 20-40 hours per week

* Initial 90-day evaluation period

* Compensation and responsibility review following successful completion of the evaluation period

* Long-term growth opportunity based on performance, accuracy, reliability, and judgment



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not follow all instructions will not be considered.



Please submit:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A link to a two-to-three-minute video introduction.

3. Complete written responses to the questions below.

4. The words “VLARI Case Coordinator” as the first line of your application.



Your video may be submitted using Loom, Google Drive, an unlisted YouTube video, or another accessible video-link service. Confirm that anyone with the link can view it.



IN YOUR VIDEO, PLEASE ADDRESS:



* Your name and current location

* Your most relevant professional experience

* The types of U.S. clients or companies you have supported

* Your experience with accounting, bookkeeping, client onboarding, insurance, or case management

* Why you are comfortable performing both administrative and analytical work

* How you communicate with a client who has not submitted required information

* Why you are interested in a long-term position



Please speak naturally. Do not simply read your résumé. Video-production quality is not important. We are evaluating your communication, professionalism, thought process, and ability to interact comfortably with clients.



WRITTEN APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Describe a situation in which you discovered missing or inaccurate information in a client file. What did you do?



2. How do you organize multiple clients, tasks, and deadlines?



3. What accounting, bookkeeping, CRM, project-management, and document-management systems have you used?



4. Describe your experience collecting information or documents from clients.



5. Are you comfortable making and receiving professional client calls? Please describe your experience.



6. How would you follow up with a client who has not responded to two document requests?



7. What would you do if a client asked you a technical question that you were not trained or authorized to answer?



8. Are you comfortable performing scheduling,
 follow-up, data entry, file organization, and other administrative tasks while learning more advanced responsibilities?



9. Are you currently working for other clients? If so, describe your current schedule and availability.



10. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



11. Please provide two professional references.



SELECTION PROCESS



Qualified applicants may be invited to:



* Attend a video interview

* Complete a short paid assessment using fictional client information

* Draft a sample client

* Review a sample file for missing information

* Prepare a brief internal case summary

* Participate in a mock client call



We are looking for someone who wants to become a dependable, trusted, and long-term member of VLARI.

title: Short-Form Content Operator / Video Editor
description:
Full-Time Remote

$750 USD/month

Monday–Friday | 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Bangkok Time (GMT+7)



About the Role



We are building a portfolio of short-form content channels across platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels.



We are looking for a Short-Form Content Operator / Video Editor to help build and operate these channels from the ground up.



This is NOT a traditional video editing position.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for us to send them videos and instructions on what to clip.



You will be responsible for researching content opportunities, campaigns, creators and niches; identifying strong source material; finding moments with viral potential; creating compelling short-form content; publishing and tracking it; analyzing performance; and helping d
 what we should scale, improve or stop.



We want someone who can think like an operator and content strategist, while also being able to execute the editing.



Our operating philosophy is simple:



Research → Test → Measure → Learn → Scale Winners → Kill Losers → Test Again



What You'll Be Responsible For

Opportunity & Niche Research



You will:



Research available content-reward and clipping opportunities

Evaluate creators, campaigns and niches

Analyze payout potential and campaign economics

Research competing short-form channels

Identify emerging content opportunities

Evaluate the amount and quality of available source material

Identify audiences and content angles

Recommend which opportunities we should launch

Propose new channels and content concepts

Identify opportunities that should be avoided



You should be able to come to us and say:



“I researched this opportunity, here's why I think it has potential, here's the audience, here's what competitors are doing, here's how we can differentiate, and here's how I would test it.”



—not simply ask us what niche you should work on.



Content Research & Selection



You will:



Research long-form source content

Watch podcasts, interviews, livestreams and other approved source material

Identify moments with the highest short-form potential

Develop compelling hooks

Understand why someone would stop scrolling

Maintain an organized source/content queue

Identify patterns in topics and moments that repeatedly perform

Short-Form Video Editing



You will:



Turn long-form content into high-retention vertical videos

Create strong openings/hooks

Add accurate and engaging captions

Remove unnecessary context and dead space

Improve pacing and storytelling

Add appropriate visual elements and pattern interrupts

Optimize videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

Follow campaign-specific content requirements



We care much more about content judgment, hooks and retention than flashy cinematic editing.



Publishing & Channel Management



You will:



Publish content across approved social platforms

Manage multiple content channels/accounts

Follow posting schedules

Write appropriate captions/titles

Follow campaign submission requirements

Maintain organized records of published content

Ensure content follows platform and campaign rules

Analytics & Experimentation



You will track and analyze:



Views

Eligible/verified views where applicable

Revenue

Revenue per video

Views per video

Retention/watch-time metrics where available

Engagement

Hook performance

Channel performance

Format performance

Campaign performance



You should constantly ask:



Why did this work?



Why did this fail?



What should we test next?



Where should we put more production?



Weekly Reporting



Each week you will prepare a report before our meeting covering:



What was produced

Portfolio performance

Revenue and key metrics

Best-performing content

Worst-performing content

Tests conducted

Results of those tests

Key learnings

New opportunities researched

Channels/formats you recommend scaling

Channels/formats you recommend reducing or stopping

Your production plan for the following week

Any decisions you need from the owner



You should bring recommendations, not just numbers.



About You



You are likely a strong fit if you are:



A critical thinker

Highly fluent in written and spoken English

A self-starter

Naturally curious

Internet and social-media savvy

Interested in what makes content go viral

Comfortable working independently

Analytical and comfortable with numbers

Organized

Detail-oriented

Fast without being careless

Comfortable testing ideas that might fail

Able to learn from data rather than becoming attached to your ideas

Comfortable researching unfamiliar niches

Able to recognize interesting stories, opinions and emotional moments

Able to explain WHY you think something will work

Someone who notices trends and patterns

Comfortable managing multiple projects/accounts simultaneously

Someone who brings solutions instead of only bringing problems



You don't need to be the world's most cinematic editor.



We would rather hire someone with excellent content instincts and strong editing ability than an amazing visual editor who cannot identify what people actually want to watch.



Not For You If...



This position is probably not for you if you:



Need constant oversight or direction

Wait to be told exactly what to do next

Only want to edit videos someone else selects for you

Plan to simply copy and repost existing videos

Think clipping means downloading someone's content and uploading it unchanged

Cannot explain why you selected a particular moment

Focus primarily on transitions/effects instead of storytelling

Are uncomfortable researching independently

Don't enjoy analyzing performance data

Ignore numbers when they contradict your opinion

Become attached to ideas that aren't performing

Don't like testing multiple concepts

Struggle to manage your own time

Need the owner to provide every source video

Need the owner to choose every niche/channel

Are looking for a passive or low-effort editing job



We want someone who eventually thinks:



“This isn't working. Here's why I think it's failing, here's what I learned, and here's where I recommend moving our production.”



Software & Technical Skills



You should be highly proficient with at least one professional short-form editing workflow, such as:



CapCut Desktop

Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve



You should also be comfortable with:



Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

Google Drive

YouTube Studio

TikTok analytics

Instagram Insights

AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for research, brainstorming and workflow support

Social-media scheduling/publishing tools



Experience with tools such as the following is a plus:



Canva

Descript

OpusClip

Metricool

Buffer

Later

Notion

Airtable



Important: AI clipping tools may assist your workflow, but they do not replace your judgment.



We are hiring you to identify opportunities, recognize great moments and understand audiences—not simply press an automatic clipping button.



Working Hours



Monday–Friday

1:00 PM–9:00 PM Bangkok Time (GMT+7)



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available and responsive during your scheduled working hours.



Some content may be scheduled to publish outside your working hours depending on channel performance data.



Compensation



$750 USD per month



There may be opportunities for additional performance-based compensation as the operation grows and demonstrates consistent profitability.



How to Apply



Start your application with the word:



PORTFOLIO



Applications that do not include this word may not be reviewed.



Please include:



3–5 examples of your best short-form videos

Tell us about one short-form channel/account you think is doing exceptionally well right now. Why do you think it works?

Find one Short, Reel or TikTok that you believe performed particularly well. Explain why you think it worked.

If you were given a 90-minute podcast and asked to find the three moments most likely to go viral, how would you d
 which moments to choose?

Tell us about your experience researching content niches, creators, competitors or social-media opportunities.

Which editing software do you use and how would you rate your proficiency from 1–10?

Which analytics, scheduling, AI or content-research tools have you used?

Have you ever managed or grown social-media accounts? If yes, please share the results.

Tell us about a time you independently identified an opportunity or problem and took action without being asked.

Confirm that you are available Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Bangkok Time (GMT+7).

Hiring Process



Candidates who pass the initial application review may be invited to a paid practical test.



The practical test will evaluate both:



Opportunity Research — your ability to research campaigns/niches and determine what you would launch.



Content Execution — your ability to review long-form source material, identify high-potential moments and turn them into compelling short-form videos.



We're not only looking for the best editor.



We're looking for the person who can help us build the best content operation.

title: # PROFESSIONAL VOICE TRAINING SPECIALIST / VOCAL COACH – ZOOM
description:
**Remote | One-on-One Training | Professional Voice Development**



I am looking for an **experienced professional voice training specialist / vocal coach** to work with me one-on-one through **Zoom**.



My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding**.



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position**. I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



* Vocal training and voice development

* **Vocal and throat anatomy**

* Breathing and breath support

* Vocal production

* Resonance

* Projection

* Pitch and pitch control

* Tone and vocal quality

* Articulation and clarity

* Vocal placement

* Voice strength and control

* Proper vocal technique

* Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

* Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



## ZOOM TRAINING



Training will primarily be done **one-on-one through Zoom**.



You should be comfortable demonstrating exercises remotely, listening carefully, correcting technique, and giving clear instructions that I can practice between sessions.



I am looking for someone who can develop a **personalized practice routine** rather than simply following a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.



You should also be able to explain the *reason* behind the exercises you recommend.



## EXPERIENCE



Please tell me:



* How many years you have professionally trained voices

* What type of clients/students you normally work with

* Your professional qualifications or training

* Whether you specialize in singing, speaking voice, vocal development, or multiple areas

* Your experience conducting voice training through Zoom

* Any particularly difficult voice-development cases you have successfully worked with



## APPLICATION — PLEASE INCLUDE YOUR RATE



**Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph.**



In your application, answer all of the following:



1. **Tell me about your professional voice-training experience.**

2. **How strong is your knowledge of vocal/throat anatomy?**

3. **What areas of the voice do you specialize in?**

4. **How would you approach improving someone's voice through Zoom?**

5. **What would you normally assess during the first session?**

6. **Please provide examples of the types of voice problems or weaknesses you have helped people improve.**

7. **Please provide your HOURLY RATE or SESSION RATE.**

8. **How long is one standard training session?**

9. **Do you offer a trial/first session? If so, what is the price?**



### IMPORTANT:



**You MUST state how much you charge in your application.**



Applications without a clear hourly or session rate may not be considered.



Please also provide a **website, profile, video, portfolio, or other evidence of your professional voice-training experience if available.**



I am looking for someone who is **professional, knowledgeable, patient, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in helping me maximize the quality of my voice.**

title: HIGH-LEVEL YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR WANTED $750-$1250 / MONTH
description:
I’m looking for a highly skilled YouTube video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis creating professional, highly engaging long-form YouTube content for my personal brand.



I’m not looking for basic cuts, captions or template-style editing.



I want someone who understands YouTube retention, storytelling, pacing and motion graphics and knows how to turn raw talking-head footage into a video that keeps people watching.



I’ll provide the raw footage, script and any specific direction needed. You’ll be responsible for bringing the video to life through the edit.



THE STYLE I'M LOOKING FOR



The content will mainly be around:



Money and finance

Investing and trading

Business

Mindset and self-development

Educational / documentary-style personal brand content



Most videos will be talking-head/scripted videos, but I want the editing to make them feel visually engaging throughout.



This means combining the main footage with B-roll, motion graphics, animations, visual examples, screenshots, charts, text and other creative elements rather than simply cutting between camera angles.



WHAT I NEED



You need to be VERY good at YouTube editing and understand what actually keeps viewers watching.



I'm looking for someone capable of:



Creating extremely engaging openings in the first 30–60 seconds

Strong pacing and removing unnecessary dead space

High-quality motion graphics and animations

Animated text and typography

Creative B-roll selection and placement

Visual storytelling that supports what I'm saying

Charts, graphs, numbers and financial concepts presented visually

Screenshots, websites and social media posts incorporated professionally

Pattern interrupts to maintain attention

Punch-ins, reframing and camera movement

Sound design and subtle sound effects

Music selection and audio mixing

Professional colour correction and grading

Clean transitions that don't feel overdone

Knowing when to make an edit visually intense and when to keep it simple

Creating a polished, premium final product



Most importantly, you need to understand viewer retention.



I don't want random effects added just for the sake of making the screen busy. Every B-roll clip, animation, graphic or transition should help tell the story, explain the point or keep the viewer engaged.



QUALITY REFERENCES



These are examples of the level and style of editing I'm looking for.



You do NOT need to copy these creators exactly. These are simply references so you understand the quality standard I'm expecting.



REFERENCE 1:





REFERENCE 2:





REFERENCE 3:





Please watch these before applying.



If you aren't confident you can produce work at or close to this standard, please don't apply.



ONGOING WORK



This is not a one-off project.



I'm building my YouTube channel seriously and want to find an editor I can work with consistently long-term.



There will be regular videos available for the right person, and potentially significantly more work as the channel grows.



You need to be:



Reliable

Responsive

Consistent

Able to follow direction

Creative enough to make editing decisions yourself

Capable of meeting agreed deadlines

Open to feedback and revisions



I'm looking for someone who can eventually understand my content and editing style well enough that I don't need to explain every little detail on every video.



TO APPLY

Your price per video and/or ongoing monthly rate.

A short explanation of how you approach viewer retention when editing a YouTube video.



IMPORTANT: Please don't send me a huge portfolio of average work.



I'd rather see 3 incredible videos than 30 average ones.



Please don't apply if you're still learning, mainly use templates, or only have basic editing experience.



I'm looking for a genuinely high-level YouTube editor who understands modern YouTube content and can help me build a premium channel over the long term.

title: Australian Tiling Estimator
description:
Construction Estimator (Tiling) — Full Time, Remote — Philippines



Elevated Tiling is a Melbourne-based tiling contractor. We're hiring a full-time remote estimator to take over our take-offs and tender pricing, follow ups & project delivery working directly with the business owner. This is a long-term position, not a short project — we're looking for someone to stay and grow with us.



The role



- Quantity take-offs for tiling, waterproofing and screed from architectural drawings and finishes schedules

- Building up tender pricing from our rate library — labour, materials, access, preliminaries

- Reading specifications and flagging scope gaps or risk before we price

- Preparing tender documents and submissions to our format

- Pricing variations and keeping supplier rates current

-
 and RFI support to builders as needed

- Monitoring tile orders and delivery



What we're looking for



- 2+ years estimating in construction — quantity surveying, civil, or a finishes trade package

- Confident reading construction drawings and doing accurate take-offs

- Bluebeam, CostX, Cubit, Buildxact or similar, plus strong Excel

- Experience on Australian projects and with Australian standards (AS 3958, AS 3740) is an advantage, not essential — we'll train you on our methods

- Strong written and spoken English

- Reliable home internet and a backup power arrangement

- Dual monitor display set up



Hours and terms



- Full time, Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm AEST (Melbourne time) — this is 7:00am–3:00pm Philippine time, shifting to 6:00am–2:00pm from October to April during Australian daylight saving

- Payment fortnightly

- Long-term, ongoing position with scope to grow into managing our full tender pipeline



To confirm you have read the job post; please type in ELEVATED in the subject line as a confirmation

title: # HOLISTIC WELLNESS / MIND-BODY PRACTITIONER
description:
**Remote / Zoom | Part-Time / Sessions | Integrative & Experiential Approaches**



I am looking for an **experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner** who has broad knowledge of different approaches to emotional well-being, personal transformation, mind-body work, and deeper patterns of the mind.



I am specifically **NOT looking only for traditional talk therapy or CBT**.



I am interested in working with someone who understands approaches that go beyond simply discussing thoughts and can work with **emotions, the body, nervous system, subconscious patterns, internal parts, beliefs, and deeper experiential processes**.



## MODALITIES I AM INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am particularly interested in applicants with professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas:



* **Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work**

* **Somatic approaches / body-based work**

* **Mind-body approaches**

* **Inner-child work**

* Emotional processing

* Nervous-system regulation

* Breathwork

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Guided visualization

* Subconscious beliefs and patterns

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment-oriented approaches

* Emotional-release techniques

* Integrative or holistic psychology

* Hypnotherapy, where appropriately trained

* Yoga / yoga-based therapeutic practices

* Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge

* Energy-oriented practices or energy healing

* Other legitimate holistic or complementary wellness modalities



I am also interested in practitioners familiar with ideas surrounding **meditation, consciousness, the mind-body connection, visualization, emotional states, and personal transformation**, including some of the themes discussed in the work of **Dr. Joe Dispenza and other mind-body/consciousness teachers**.



However, I am **not looking for someone who simply follows one teacher or repeats spiritual ideas**. I want someone with real training, experience, critical thinking, and a broad understanding of different modalities.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is educational.



I want someone who can help me understand:



**What different modalities exist? How do they work? What is each one designed to address? What happens during a session? How are they different from conventional talk therapy?**



Where appropriate to your qualifications and scope of practice, I would also like to **experience and practice different techniques through Zoom sessions**, rather than only hearing about them theoretically.



I am interested in discovering approaches that work with the person on multiple levels — **mind, emotions, body, internal patterns, habits, beliefs, awareness, and overall well-being.**



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person might be a:



* Holistic wellness practitioner

* Mind-body practitioner

* Integrative therapist or counselor

* IFS-informed/trained practitioner

* Somatic practitioner

* Trauma-informed practitioner

* Breathwork practitioner

* Meditation/mindfulness teacher

* Hypnotherapist

* Holistic coach with substantial professional training

* Acupuncture/TCM professional with mind-body knowledge

* Integrative wellness practitioner

* Or someone professionally trained across several related modalities



You should be able to clearly distinguish **which modalities you are formally trained/certified/licensed in, which you have practical experience with, and which you are simply knowledgeable about.**



## IMPORTANT



I value open-mindedness, but I also value **professionalism and honesty**.



Please do not claim that a particular technique can cure a medical or psychological condition unless that claim is within your professional scope and supported appropriately.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, acupuncturist, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay — just clearly state your actual qualifications and professional scope.



I am looking for someone who knows **what they know and what they do not know**.



## ZOOM SESSIONS



Sessions will primarily take place remotely through **Zoom**.



You should be comfortable:



* Teaching and explaining different modalities

* Guiding appropriate exercises remotely

* Giving personalized practices between sessions

* Discussing what we observed during an exercise

* Recommending which approaches may be worth exploring further

* Explaining when something should instead be handled by an appropriately licensed or in-person professional



If a modality genuinely requires in-person treatment — for example, acupuncture — I can work with an appropriate local professional. You can still help educate me about the modality and how it fits into the larger mind-body picture.



## APPLICATION



Please answer the following: 



1. **What is your professional background, education, training, licenses, and certifications?**



2. **Which holistic, therapeutic, somatic, mind-body, or complementary modalities are you professionally trained in?**



3. **Do you have experience with IFS/parts work, somatic work, inner-child work, nervous-system regulation, breathwork, meditation, or subconscious-pattern work? Please explain.**



4. **What other modalities do you know that I did not mention in this job post?**



5. **How do you view the relationship between the mind, emotions, nervous system, body, and behavior?**



6. **Are you familiar with Dr. Joe Dispenza or similar mind-body/consciousness approaches? If yes, please explain your perspective and experience.**



7. **If we worked together, how would you structure our first few Zoom sessions?**



8. **Which techniques can you personally guide through Zoom, and which would require an in-person practitioner?**



9. **Please state your HOURLY RATE or SESSION RATE and the normal length of your sessions.**



### YOUR RATE MUST BE INCLUDED.



## HOW TO CONTACT ME



**Primary application:** Please apply through **OnlineJobs.ph**.



**Alternative:** You may also contact me directly on **WhatsApp** at:



**WhatsApp: 
**



If contacting me through WhatsApp, please introduce yourself, briefly explain your professional background and the modalities you specialize in, and include your **hourly/session rate**.



I am especially interested in finding someone who has studied **multiple approaches**, is deeply curious about the mind-body connection, and can help me explore this field in a **professional, grounded, individualized, and experiential way**.

title: Basic Headline Editor
description:
Basic Headline Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Senior Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive and dependable Senior Virtual Assistant to join the core remote team of a Hong Kong-based company.

This is not a basic task-based VA position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recurring workflows, work independently, maintain accurate records and ensure responsibilities are completed without repeated follow-up.

You will work across different departments based on company requirements and your strongest skills. Areas may include Operations, Supply Chain, Government Documentation and Administration.



Key Responsibilities



- Own and manage assigned recurring workflows from start to finish.

- Manage deadlines, follow-ups and recurring tasks independently.

- Maintain accurate ClickUp tasks, spreadsheets, records and documentation.

- Create, maintain and improve SOPs and working processes.

- Check your own work for accuracy before completion.

- Identify problems, missing information and process gaps early.

- Escalate issues before they become failures.

- Coordinate with team members, suppliers and external parties when required.

- Support and guide Junior Virtual Assistants on workflows within your responsibility.

- Conduct research and turn findings into clear actions or recommendations.

- Support cross-department projects and operational requirements.

- Depending on your primary area, work may include:

- Supply Chain & Operations: supplier communication, purchase orders, shipments, inventory records, product information, price lists, spreadsheets and coordination between departments.

- Government & Operations: vehicle registration documentation, applications, document preparation, tracking, deadlines, record keeping and operational support.

- Responsibilities may shift between departments based on workload, company priorities and individual strengths.



What We Expect



- Ownership: If something is assigned to you, you follow it through to completion.

- Accuracy: Management should not need to repeatedly find and correct mistakes.

- Follow-through: You close loops without being chased.

- Early escalation: If something is blocked, unclear or at risk, you raise it early.

- Process improvement: If something repeatedly does not work, you identify the problem and suggest a better way.

- Adaptability: You are comfortable learning new responsibilities and working across departments.



Qualifications & Skills



Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organization, accuracy and attention to detail.

Strong follow-up and time-management skills.

Experience working independently in a remote environment.

Experience managing recurring workflows or administrative processes.

Strong documentation and SOP-writing ability.

Comfortable with spreadsheets and structured data.

Experience with ClickUp or similar project-management software.

Comfortable using modern AI tools for work and research.

Able to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

Able to manage multiple priorities without constant supervision.

Experience in operations, supply chain, logistics, government documentation, inventory or administration is an advantage but not required.

We value ownership, learning ability and reliability more than experience in an identical industry.



How Success Is Measured



Success means your workflows run accurately and on time, records stay updated, problems are raised early, and management does not need to repeatedly remind you or check your work.

We are a small, fast-moving company with clear expectations and direct feedback. This role suits someone who wants responsibility, enjoys improving how work gets done and can operate independently.

title: AI & Automation Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for a technically curious and highly trainable AI & Automation Virtual Assistant to join the core remote team of a Hong Kong-based company.

This role combines normal Virtual Assistant execution with a strong focus on AI tools, automation, research, testing and technology support.

You will complete recurring operational tasks while also helping the team improve how work is done using AI and automation.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys experimenting with new tools, learning how systems connect and finding faster ways to complete repetitive work.



Key Responsibilities



Complete assigned recurring and operational tasks accurately and on time.

Use AI tools to support research, documentation, data processing and daily execution.

Assist with building, testing and maintaining simple automations and workflows.

Research new AI tools, software and automation opportunities.

Keep company tools, documentation and internal systems updated.

Test new workflows and report errors, limitations and improvement opportunities.

Create clear documentation and SOPs for tools and automated processes.

Update ClickUp, spreadsheets, databases and other company systems.

Support Gerald, Turqey and other team members with AI-related research and technical execution.

Help identify repetitive manual tasks that could be simplified or automated.

Support cross-department recurring work when required.



What We Expect



Technical curiosity: You actively explore new AI tools and technology.

Execution: You can still complete normal recurring work accurately and consistently.

Problem solving: You investigate issues before immediately escalating them.

Accuracy: Automations and AI outputs must be checked before being trusted.

Documentation: If you build or change something, another person should be able to understand how it works.

Continuous learning: AI tools change quickly. You are expected to keep learning and adapting.

Qualifications & Skills

Strong interest in AI, automation and technology.

Regular experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar.

Comfortable learning new software without extensive training.

Good written and spoken English.

Strong research and problem-solving ability.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, structured data and online systems.

Experience with ClickUp or similar project-management software is an advantage.

Experience with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n or similar is a strong advantage.

Basic understanding of APIs, databases, scripting or no-code tools is an advantage but not required.

Strong attention to detail.

Able to follow SOPs and complete recurring tasks reliably.

Comfortable working across different departments.

description:

Job Details:



Video Editing (Long-Form)



- Edit raw footage into polished, retention-optimized long-form YouTube videos (7–15 min) for both channels, matching each channel's distinct tone (raw/personal vs. polished/authority)

- Add captions/subtitles, b-roll, sound design, music, transitions, and basic color correction

Short-Form Clipping

- Edit B-roll clips using the "Edits" app on Instagram using provided B-roll



Thumbnails & Metadata

- Write SEO-friendly titles, descriptions, and tags

- Suggest thumbnail/title A-B test options when relevant



Scheduling & Publishing



- Upload and schedule finished videos and shorts across both channels on a consistent posting calendar

- Manage a content calendar so both channels stay on a predictable release schedule

- Cross-post/schedule shorts to TikTok and Instagram Reels where applicable

- Organize raw footage, project files, and finished assets in shared drive folders

- Monitor comments and flag ones that need a personal reply from me

- Track basic performance metrics (views, retention, CTR) and report weekly on what's working

Your resume/CV

A portfolio or links to YouTube videos/channels you've edited (long-form and shorts examples)

Your available hours per week and preferred schedule

Your rate expectation (hourly or monthly)

In the subject line, write "WICK EDITOR" so I know you read the full listing

title: Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced, highly accurate and dependable Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant to support multiple companies within our group.

Your primary responsibility will be Finance and Bookkeeping, ensuring our financial records are accurate, current and properly reconciled.

As part of a small cross-functional team, you will also support HR administration, compliance, contracts, legal documentation and general company administration when required.

This role requires someone who can take ownership of recurring finance workflows, identify discrepancies independently and ensure issues are resolved without repeated management follow-up.



Key Responsibilities



Finance & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple companies.

Record and correctly categorize income, expenses, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, payment account and balance reconciliations.

Maintain accurate general ledger records in Xero.

Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports.

Review financial records for missing entries, incorrect classifications and discrepancies.

Maintain supporting documents, invoices, receipts and financial records.

Assist with payroll preparation and employee payment records.

Coordinate financial information required by accountants, auditors, banks and other external parties.

Support inventory and purchase reconciliation with the Supply Chain team.

Maintain and improve bookkeeping SOPs, checklists and recurring finance workflows.

HR, Legal & Administration

Maintain employee records, contracts and HR documentation.

Support onboarding, offboarding and recurring HR administration.

Track important company, contract, insurance, licence and compliance deadlines.

Prepare and organize documents for management, external accountants, lawyers and other professional service providers.

Follow up on outstanding documents, signatures, filings and administrative requirements.

Support other administrative requirements across the company when needed.



What We Expect



Accuracy: Financial information must be checked before it is reported.

Ownership: If something does not reconcile or information is missing, investigate and follow through until it is resolved.

Timeliness: Monthly accounts and recurring finance tasks must stay current.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

Documentation: Records must be organized so another person can understand and verify the work.

Improvement: Identify recurring errors or inefficient processes and recommend practical improvements.



Qualifications & Skills



Minimum 2–3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong hands-on experience with Xero.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and financial statements.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Able to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.

Good written and spoken English.

Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools for research and administrative work.

Experience with inventory-based businesses is an advantage.

Experience with Dext, Cin7 or similar systems is an advantage.

HR or administrative experience is an advantage but not required.

Accounting or Finance qualifications are preferred, but demonstrated practical bookkeeping capability and accuracy are more important.



How Success Is Measured



Success means the company accounts remain accurate, reconciled and up to date, monthly financial information can be relied upon, outstanding issues are identified early, and management does not need to repeatedly check or chase routine Finance, HR and administrative work.

This role suits someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for accuracy and wants broader exposure beyond bookkeeping within a small company.
