title: Automotive Estimator
description:
AUTOMOTIVE OPERATIONS & DISPATCH COORDINATOR

-We’re hiring a high-performing, detail-obsessed Operations Coordinator to help us run and grow a mobile automotive shop in Austin, Texas — a premium mobile tire and oil change business serving performance car owners and select fleets in the Austin metro area.

-This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

-You’ll also assist with light marketing coordination (e.g., newsletter support, gathering photos from the team) — just a few hours weekly.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Fleet & Retail Ops Coordination

-Own the estimate-to-approval-to-route workflow:

-Create and submit estimates

-Follow up for approval

-Ensure parts are sourced

-Finalize tech routes for the following day

-Track all jobs in progress and flag issues proactively

-Ensure routes are realistic and efficient; confirm techs are prepped and ready

-Communicate clearly with customers and fleet managers about job timing, status, and follow-ups

-Submit and close out fleet approvals in Element, LeasePlan, and AutoIntegrate

-Ensure invoices match approvals; follow up on outstanding invoices and missing payments



2. Scheduling & Productivity Tracking

-Maintain the daily technician schedule, making updates as needed

-Monitor tech productivity; flag idle time, reschedules, or delays

-Track time logs and coordinate with bookkeeper for payroll



3. Customer Communication

-Respond to incoming texts, WhatsApp messages, and system inquiries in a timely, professional manner

-Follow up with clients as needed to resolve open issues or gather job-related info

-Escalate concerns appropriately and promptly



4. Admin & Reporting

-Submit a detailed Daily Recap covering completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and KPIs

-Keep Trello and other tools up-to-date with accurate job and task statuses

-Track inventory needs and coordinate ordering of parts, oil, and supplies

-Monitor A/R and follow up on past-due fleet invoices



5. Marketing & Content Support

-Publish our monthly newsletter in MailChimp with content from marketing team

-Coordinate publishing of content to Instagram /
 / Google My Business

-Other light admin support as needed for the marketing team

-What Success Looks Like

-All work orders, estimates, approvals, and tech routes are handled with zero dropped balls

-You identify blockers or problems before they become fires

-Communication is clear, timely, and professional — with both customers and internal team

-The business runs like a machine — nothing gets missed or delayed

-You take full ownership of your responsibilities and require very little follow-up



Who You Are

-A natural systems thinker who thrives on clarity, organization, and ownership

-Extremely proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do

-Excellent at written and verbal English communication

-Comfortable in the automotive world and eager to learn the details

-Sharp and reliable — you retain info, spot gaps, and follow through



Experience & Skills Required

-3+ years of experience in a remote automotive: coordinator, dispatcher, operations role

-Demonstrated responsibility for keeping things moving without handholding

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Experience with dispatch, route planning, or technician scheduling

-Familiar with tools like Slack, Google Docs, Trello (or similar), CRM/invoicing platforms

-Experience working with U.S.-based field service, auto, or fleet companies

-Bonus: Familiarity with AutoIntegrate, Housecall Pro, Element, or LeasePlan platforms



Required Software Experience

-Slack

-WhatsApp

-Trello (or similar)

-Google Workspace

-CRM / invoicing tools (Housecall Pro, AutoIntegrate)


 (plus)



TECH REQUIREMENTS:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

-Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed

-Dual monitor setup is required to ensure efficiency in managing multiple applications simultaneously.



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Part-time, US hours



Schedule

-Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM–7:00 PM CST

-Saturday: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM CST

-Sunday: 12:00 PM–4:00 PM CST

Note: Flexibility is required, as the shift schedule may change. The schedule consists of 7 shifts across 2 weeks.



Pay: ₱288.46 - ₱432.69 hourly rate

title: Get Paid to Scroll TikTok & Find Viral Clips
description:
I’m looking for someone to find engaging clips and real-life stories on TikTok,
/X, and Instagram that I can turn into YouTube Shorts.



The ideal clip tells a complete story: it introduces a situation, something interesting happens, and it ends with a satisfying or unexpected payoff. It should make viewers curious enough to keep watching.



Clips should have:



* An interesting, unusual, wholesome, funny, or impressive real-life story.

* A clear beginning, development or problem, and ending.

* Good-quality footage that’s easy to follow.

* Preferably recent content that hasn’t already been widely reused.



Please avoid politics, serious violence or fighting, and anything graphic, disturbing, or overly controversial. Harmless joking or playful interactions are fine.



You won’t need to edit videos. Your job is simply to find suitable clips or story ideas and send the links.



Starting pay is **$4 per qualified idea**. Consistently strong work could lead to a long-term position with regular salary-based pay and bonuses for exceptional finds. The channel is growing quickly and recently passed **100,000 views in 24 hours**.



To apply, send **ONE clip or story from the past few days**, including:



* The original link.

* One or two sentences explaining what happens.



Take your time and choose something you believe would make a compelling Short. I’ll review every application, so there’s no advantage to rushing or submitting the first viral clip you see.



What matters most is your ability to recognize a strong story.

title: U.S. Payroll Accountant / Payroll Operations Specialist
description:
Please Note

Applicants without strong hands-on experience in U.S. payroll processing and payroll accounting will not be considered.



Candidates may come from an HR, Finance, or Accounting background, but they must have extensive payroll expertise, including end-to-end multi-state U.S. payroll processing, payroll audits, reconciliations, journal entries, payroll reporting, and compliance.



Strong proficiency in payroll systems, preferably Rippling and advanced Excel skills are required.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly capable U.S. Payroll Accountant / Payroll Operations Specialist to join our Finance team.



This role is responsible for managing accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for employees across multiple U.S. states. The successful candidate will oversee payroll calculations, audits, reconciliations, accounting entries, tax reporting, employee deductions, and payroll-related financial reporting.



This position is ideal for an experienced payroll professional who combines strong operational payroll knowledge with a solid understanding of accounting principles. You should be comfortable managing payroll independently, investigating discrepancies, maintaining strong internal controls, and ensuring all payroll records are accurate and audit-ready.



What You’ll Do

*End-to-End U.S. Payroll Processing

Manage the complete payroll cycle for employees across multiple U.S. states

Process regular, supplemental, bonus, commission, and off-cycle payrolls

Review and validate employee earnings, deductions, reimbursements, garnishments, and tax withholdings

title: Outbound Appointment Setter, US Retirement
description:
We call people in the United States who have asked for information about retirement income. You find out what they are trying to work out, check whether they fit, and then connect them live to a licensed insurance agent. You introduce the two of them and drop off the call.



You are not selling anything. You are not licensed and you will not be. If a caller asks you what a product pays or whether they should buy it, the answer is always that the agent will cover it.



- **$5.00 USD per hour**, paid for every hour you work

- **$3 for every transfer the client accepts.** $4 each once you pass 10 accepted in a week, $5 each once you pass 20. This resets every week

- **$15 bonus** in any week where 80% or more of your transfers are accepted and at least 10 were accepted

- Paid every two weeks, in USD



A typical week at 40 hours and 15 accepted transfers works out around $265.



One thing to be clear about, because it surprises people. The per-transfer pay is on transfers the **client accepts**. If you connect somebody who turns out to be in the wrong state, or well under the asset range, or who did not understand what the call was, the client rejects it and it does not pay. If it had already been paid, it comes off a later period. Your hourly base is never affected by any of this.



We would rather have three transfers a day that the client accepts than ten that fall apart. Three a day is what puts you into the higher rate tier, and if your acceptance rate holds at 80% or better it also earns the weekly bonus. The pay is built around quality, not volume.



**What you need**



- Clear spoken English. Our callers are 55 and older and they need to understand you the first time

- A wired USB headset with a microphone

- A computer that can run a dialer and two browser tabs without struggling

- Reliable internet, **25 Mbps down and 10 up minimum**, wired preferred, and a plan for when the power goes

- A quiet place to work with no background noise

- Able to work 9:00pm to 6:00am Manila, Monday to Saturday



**What we are looking for**



Someone who can follow a script and still sound like a person. Someone who does not push. The most expensive mistake in this job is talking somebody onto the line who did not want to be there, so if your instinct is to keep going until you get a yes, we are not a fit.



**What the process is**



1. You fill in one form. 
 

It takes about ten minutes and it ends with a 60-second voice recording. 

2. We score it and reply either way.

3. A 20-minute interview on video. Ten minutes of it is a role-play, where you read our opening and handle two objections. We send you the script in advance.

4. An offer.



We reply to everyone who submits a voice sample.



**How to apply**

Submit your application here: 

To show you read this: start your 60-second voice recording with the word: "Pineapple"

ABOUT THE ROLE

I would much rather find someone who is curious, learns quickly, communicates well and takes ownership.





WHAT YOU WILL INITIALLY HELP WITH





VIDEO & CONTENT

You do not need to be a professional web developer. For complicated technical work, we will use specialists.





ORGANISATION & OPERATIONS



• Keep files and folders organised

• Maintain project and task lists

• Document processes and create simple SOPs

• Help ensure projects actually get completed

• Research tools, opportunities and solutions when required





THE PERSON I'M LOOKING FOR



Technical skills matter, but your attitude and way of thinking matter more.



I am looking for someone who is:



• Reliable

• Highly organised

• Curious

• Resourceful

• Comfortable learning new software

• Good at written English

• Detail-oriented

• Comfortable working independently

• Willing to ask questions when necessary

• Able to research a problem before asking me to solve it

• Interested in developing a long-term working relationship



I don't expect you to know everything.



I do expect you to be willing to learn.





USEFUL SKILLS



Experience with some of the following would be valuable:



• CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or similar

• Canva

• Instagram and

• YouTube / YouTube Studio

• WordPress or similar website platforms

• Google Drive / Docs / Sheets

•
 marketing platforms

• AI tools such as ChatGPT

• Project management tools



You do NOT need experience with every tool listed above.



Please don't apply claiming that you are an "expert" in everything.



I'd much rather understand what you are genuinely good at and what you would need to learn.





ABOUT THE WORKING RELATIONSHIP



I expect to begin at approximately 15–20 hours per week.



The schedule can be relatively flexible, although we will need some agreed working-time overlap for communication.



This is intended to become a long-term position for the right person.



As you understand the business and demonstrate that you can take ownership, I would like to increase your responsibility.



For the right person, there may also be opportunities to increase hours and compensation over time.



I'm particularly interested in finding someone who wants to grow alongside a business rather than simply complete a list of tasks.





READY TO APPLY?



Your application is the first stage of our screening process.



Please read the instructions carefully and answer ALL of the questions below.



Please don't send me a generic AI-generated cover letter.



Using AI is completely acceptable — in fact, we use AI extensively. But I want to understand YOU and how you think.





HOW TO APPLY





1. INTRODUCE YOURSELF



Maximum 150 words.



Tell me something useful that I wouldn't learn simply by reading your CV.





2. WHAT ARE THE THREE SKILLS YOU ARE STRONGEST AT?



Be specific.





3. WHAT IS SOMETHING YOU TAUGHT YOURSELF DURING THE LAST 12 MONTHS?



Tell me:



• What you learned

• Why you learned it

• How you learned it





4. IMAGINE I GIVE YOU A TASK YOU HAVE NEVER DONE BEFORE.



What would you normally do before coming back to me for help?





5. LOOK UP WATER THERAPY ICELAND AND WATSU.



Spend no more than 15 minutes researching.



Then tell me, in your own words:



What do you think we are really selling?



There is no single correct answer. I'm interested in how you think.





6. SHOW ME YOUR WORK.



Please provide links to up to THREE examples of your best work.



Video editing, social content, graphic design, websites or another relevant project are all acceptable.



For each one, briefly explain what YOU personally did.





7. TELL ME ABOUT AI.



Which AI tools do you currently use?



Give me one example of how AI has genuinely made you better or faster at your work.





8. WHERE WOULD YOU LIKE YOUR CAREER TO BE IN 2–3 YEARS?



What would you particularly like to become better at?





9. AVAILABILITY



Please tell me:



• Hours available per week

• Current work commitments

• Preferred working hours

• Expected hourly/monthly compensation

• Earliest possible start date





FINAL INSTRUCTION



Start your application with the words:



WATER MOVES



This simply tells me that you read the entire job description.



Applications that don't include these words will not proceed to the next stage.



Thank you. I'm looking forward to meeting the person who may eventually become an important part of what we're building.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a writer and speaker on AI in innovation and higher education. You'll run my marketing — website, social, content, newsletter, outreach, campaigns, and the numbers behind them.



This job is lead generation. I want to be visible, and I want to be visibly different from everyone else saying the same things about AI. That's what the work is for.



The work is Claude-first: most of it starts as an AI draft that you direct, edit, and publish.



Higher education experience is a plus, not a requirement. I'll bring the subject matter.



HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY GETS DONE



Your job is to edit and post AI content.



Nearly everything — posts, newsletter copy, research,
s, campaign plans — starts as a Claude output. You direct the prompt, edit what comes back, fact-check it, make it sound like me, and publish it. Then you do it again tomorrow.



That's the job. If you're looking for work where you write everything from scratch, this isn't it. If you're already working this way and want more of it, keep reading.



I use Claude myself, daily. I'm not asking you to learn a tool I don't understand — I'll know the difference between a good prompt and a lazy one.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



Not a virtual assistant role. No calendar management, no inbox triage, no data entry.

Not B2C. All of your experience must be B2B. If your background is ecommerce, dropshipping, or consumer social, this won't translate.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Website and social



Maintain and update the website — pages, posts, speaking and media sections

Run the social channels day to day, LinkedIn first

Create simple graphics (Canva-level)



Content



Edit and publish AI-drafted content across LinkedIn, the website, and social

Launch and run a weekly newsletter — from setup through send



Outreach



 outreach and nurture sequences

Pitch and follow up with podcasts, publications, conferences, and event organizers

Build and maintain the contact lists behind all of it



Campaigns



Plan and run campaigns end to end — book and report launches, events, speaking announcements

Coordinate timing across channels so a launch lands as one thing, not five



Research and engagement



Research topics, sources, and stories to feed the content pipeline

Monitor and respond to comments in real time

Track what's being said in the AI, innovation, and higher-ed conversation and flag what I should weigh in on



Measurement



Track open rates, click rates, traffic, engagement, follower growth, and inbound inquiries

Report weekly: what moved, what didn't, what you're changing next week

I don't want a dashboard. I want to know what to do differently.



Project management



Keep projects moving without me chasing you

Track your own work, own your own deadlines, flag blockers early



REQUIREMENTS



Daily Claude use. Not "I've tried ChatGPT." Actual daily use, and you can show me how you work.

Exceptional organizational skills. You track your own work and I don't have to follow up.

Exceptional speed. Turnaround in hours, not days.

Solid B2B marketing knowledge — integrated marketing, communications, content development, campaign management.

Comfortable with numbers. You read metrics and act on them.

Comfortable with technology. You figure new tools out yourself.

Strong written English. You'll be editing AI output until it stops sounding like AI. That's a real skill and it's most of the job.

Light graphic design. Canva-level is fine.

Overlap with US Pacific business hours — at least four hours a day.



Nice to have: higher education or edtech experience; thought leadership, PR, or editorial background; newsletter operations.



HOURS AND TERMS



Part-time or full-time depending on your skills. Tell me which you want and what you can do.



Paid trial task before anything ongoing.

title: VIDEO EDITOR & SEO CONTENT SPECIALIST
description:
VIDEO EDITOR & SEO CONTENT SPECIALIST



**Work Arrangement:** Remote

**Position Type:** Full
-Time

**Reports To:** Marketing / Executive Leadership



 POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a creative, technically skilled, and results-oriented **Video Editor & SEO Content Specialist** to help grow our company's digital presence through professional video content, YouTube optimization, search engine optimization, and content distribution.



This position goes beyond simply editing videos.



The successful candidate will be responsible for helping transform raw footage, interviews, podcasts, educational content, customer stories, and promotional videos into professional content that is designed to **attract attention, rank in search, increase engagement, generate leads, and strengthen our brand.**



The ideal candidate understands both:



**VIDEO PRODUCTION + CONTENT DISCOVERY**



We want someone who understands that producing a great video is only part of the job. The content must also be properly packaged, optimized, published, and analyzed so the right audience can find it.



---



# PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. VIDEO EDITING & PRODUCTION



Edit professional video content for platforms including:



* YouTube

*

* Instagram

* TikTok

* LinkedIn

* Company websites

* Podcasts

* Training platforms

*
 and marketing campaigns



Responsibilities include:



* Edit raw video footage into polished finished content.

* Remove unnecessary footage, pauses, mistakes, and distractions.

* Improve pacing and storytelling.

* Add professional transitions when appropriate.

* Add titles and lower thirds.

* Add captions and subtitles.

* Add logos and brand elements.

* Incorporate B-roll.

* Add graphics and motion graphics.

* Perform basic audio cleanup and enhancement.

* Perform basic color correction.

* Select appropriate music and sound effects.

* Create professional intros and outros when needed.

* Export content in the correct formats and resolutions for each platform.



The goal is not simply to make videos look good.



The goal is to make people **want to continue watching them.**



---



# 2. YOUTUBE CHANNEL MANAGEMENT



Help develop and grow the company's YouTube presence.



Responsibilities include:



* Upload and publish videos.

* Optimize video titles.

* Write SEO-focused descriptions.

* Conduct keyword research.

* Add appropriate tags and metadata.

* Create and manage playlists.

* Add chapters/timestamps.

* Add cards and end screens where appropriate.

* Optimize thumbnails.

* Maintain consistent channel branding.

* Organize existing video content.

* Update older videos when optimization opportunities exist.

* Monitor comments and engagement as assigned.

* Help develop the publishing calendar.



The Video Editor & SEO Content Specialist should understand the relationship between:



**TITLE → THUMBNAIL → CLICK → WATCH TIME → ENGAGEMENT → CONVERSION**



---



# 3. VIDEO SEO



SEO knowledge is a major requirement of this position.



The candidate should understand how people search for information and how content can be structured to increase its chances of being discovered.



Responsibilities include:



* Perform keyword research before content is published.

* Identify relevant search topics.

* Research search intent.

* Recommend SEO-friendly video topics.

* Optimize video titles.

* Optimize descriptions.

* Create keyword-focused chapters.

* Recommend supporting website content when appropriate.

* Identify long-tail search opportunities.

* Analyze competitor content.

* Monitor video search performance.

* Recommend improvements based on performance data.



The candidate should understand that we do not want to create content simply because **we want to talk about something.**



We want to understand:



**What is our target customer searching for?**



Then create valuable content around those searches.



---



# 4. WEBSITE & CONTENT SEO SUPPORT



The ideal candidate should also understand fundamental website SEO.



Responsibilities may include:



* Keyword research.

* On-page SEO recommendations.

* Page titles and meta descriptions.

* Heading structure.

* Internal linking recommendations.

* Image/video optimization.

* Video embedding strategies.

* Content optimization.

* Local SEO content opportunities.

* Google search performance analysis.

* Identifying topics for future articles, landing pages, and videos.



Advanced technical SEO knowledge is helpful but is not required to the same degree as video and content SEO.



---



# 5. LONG-FORM TO SHORT-FORM CONTENT



One major responsibility will be maximizing the value of every piece of content we produce.



For example:



**1 Podcast**



could become:



**1 Full YouTube Episode**



→ 5–10 YouTube Shorts



→ 5–10 Instagram/Facebook Reels



→ TikTok clips



→ LinkedIn clips



→ Quote graphics



→ Website content



→
 content



→ Future promotional material



The candidate should actively identify opportunities to **repurpose content instead of allowing valuable footage to be used only once.**



---



# 6. PODCAST & INTERVIEW EDITING



The candidate may be responsible for editing company podcasts and interview-style content.



Responsibilities may include:



* Multi-camera editing.

* Audio synchronization.

* Removing unnecessary pauses and mistakes.

* Improving conversational pacing.

* Adding speaker identification.

* Creating intros and outros.

* Adding graphics and supporting visuals.

* Creating promotional clips.

* Creating Shorts/Reels from long-form episodes.

* Optimizing podcast/video titles and descriptions for discovery.



---



# 7. THUMBNAILS & VISUAL PACKAGING



The candidate should understand the importance of thumbnails and visual presentation.



Responsibilities include:



* Create compelling YouTube thumbnails.

* Maintain brand consistency.

* Test different thumbnail concepts.

* Use readable typography.

* Select compelling video frames.

* Create curiosity without misleading viewers.

* Monitor click-through rates.

* Recommend thumbnail changes when performance is weak.



Graphic design experience is highly desirable.



---



# 8. CONTENT STRATEGY



We want this person to contribute ideas—not simply wait for footage.



The candidate should help answer:



* What should we create?

* Who is the target audience?

* What are they searching for?

* What problems can we help them solve?

* Which videos are performing best?

* What topics should we create next?

* What content can be repurposed?

* Which content is generating leads?

* What should we stop doing?



This position should help turn video production into a **repeatable content engine.**



---



# 9. ANALYTICS & PERFORMANCE REPORTING



The candidate should use data to improve future content.



Monitor metrics such as:



* Views

* Impressions

* Click-through rate

* Watch time

* Average view duration

* Audience retention

* Subscriber growth

* Search traffic

* Engagement

* Website traffic from video

* Leads generated

* Conversion opportunities



Prepare regular reports explaining:



**What worked?**



**What didn't?**



**Why?**



**What should we do next?**



---



# 10. AI-ASSISTED CONTENT PRODUCTION



The candidate should be comfortable using modern AI tools responsibly to improve productivity.



AI may be used to assist with:



* Transcription

* Captioning

* Content research

* Keyword research

* Video summaries

* Title concepts

* Description drafts

* Short-form content identification

* Content repurposing

* Script development

* Thumbnail concepts

* Content calendars



AI should improve productivity—not replace judgment, creativity, or quality control.



---



# REQUIRED SKILLS



Candidates should have strong experience in:



* Professional video editing

* YouTube content production

* Video SEO

* Keyword research

* YouTube optimization

* Short-form video editing

* Long-form video editing

* Audio editing

* Captioning/subtitles

* Content repurposing

* Thumbnail development

* Content analytics



Candidates should also have strong written English and the ability to create compelling titles, descriptions, and supporting copy.



---



# PREFERRED SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe After Effects

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Audition

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut

* Canva



SEO/analytics experience may include tools such as:



* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics

* Google Trends

* YouTube Analytics

* YouTube Studio

* TubeBuddy

* vidIQ

* SEMrush

* Ahrefs

* Similar keyword and SEO research platforms



---



# IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who thinks:



**"How do we make this video better?"**



but also:



**"How will people find this video?"**



**"Why would they click it?"**



**"Why would they continue watching?"**



**"What should they do after watching?"**



**"How can we turn this one video into ten pieces of content?"**



**"How do we know whether this content actually helped grow the business?"**



We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of a:



**Video Editor + SEO Specialist + Content Marketer**



---



# KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



Performance may be evaluated using:



* Videos completed on schedule

* Editing turnaround time

* Content published per week/month

* Long-form videos produced

* Short-form clips produced

* YouTube impressions

* YouTube click-through rate

* Watch time

* Average audience retention

* Subscriber growth

* Organic search traffic

* Keyword rankings

* Engagement

* Website traffic generated

* Leads attributed to content

* Content repurposing rate



We care about **quality and business results**, not simply the number of videos produced.



---



# WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After becoming established in this position, the company should have a consistent content-production system:



**RESEARCH → PLAN → RECORD → EDIT → OPTIMIZE → PUBLISH → DISTRIBUTE → REPURPOSE → MEASURE → IMPROVE**



Raw footage should not sit unused.



Videos should not be uploaded without optimization.



Long-form content should create additional short-form content.



Performance data should influence future content decisions.



Our goal is to build a growing library of useful, searchable, professional content that continues attracting potential customers long after it is originally published.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Applicants should provide:



1. Resume or work history.

2. Video editing portfolio.

3. Links to YouTube channels or content they have edited.

4. Examples of short-form content.

5. Examples demonstrating SEO or YouTube optimization experience.

6. A brief explanation of how they would optimize a new YouTube video for search and discovery.

7. The video editing and SEO tools they currently use.



Please be prepared to explain **what you personally contributed** to portfolio examples.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a brief practical video editing and SEO exercise.

title: DTC SUPPLEMENT BRAND — CREATIVE STRATEGIST
description:
THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE.



We're looking for someone with years of experience behind them who wants to try something new. If you're early in your career or looking to learn on the job, this isn't the right fit. We need someone who already knows how to do this work and is ready to apply it to a mission they believe in. This is a remote work.



ABOUT US



We're a mission-driven health supplement startup focused on habit breaking. We're on pace to do $1M+ per month within the first 90 days. We're building a brand that solves real problems for people who want to change their behavior and break destructive cycles. We're systematized: locked creative angles, sub-angle maps, customer research libraries, and proven winner-iteration workflows. Your job is to research deeply, find opportunities, develop strong DR concepts and scripts, and keep producing ideas that can take meaningful spend.



YOUR ROLE



We want a creative strategist who shares our mission and can find new scalable concepts, expand current winners, and push into new awareness levels and broader audiences. You're not writing concepts and waiting weeks to see them tested. You have a full editing team behind you, as much editing capacity as your concepts need, significant spend to test ideas quickly, and direct access to performance data and fast feedback loops.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. RESEARCH & ANGLE DEVELOPMENT

2. CONCEPT CREATION & SCRIPTING

3. PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS & ITERATION







WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required



* Real creative strategy experience in health and supplements

* Deep understanding of DR, awareness levels, mechanisms, psychology, and copy

* Proven ability to think independently and develop original angles, not just remix competitors

* Track record: creatives you've developed that have already taken meaningful spend

* Ability to research independently: pull Reddit threads, run competitor scans, analyze reviews and survey data

* You generate 20+ concepts per week, reviewing your own work before handoff

* You own the creative review on every video your editors submit

* Mission alignment: you believe in helping people break habits and change behavior



Strongly preferred



* Experience running multiple concepts simultaneously across different angles

* Familiarity with Meta Ad Library and ad account performance metrics

* Background analyzing what's working in the supplement vertical specifically

* Experience with winner iteration and scaling proven concepts











HOW YOU WORK



* You do your own research instead of waiting on us for briefs or competitor data

* You review your own concepts before they go to editors. Nobody QCs your work for you.

* You review every video your editors submit and provide clear revision notes

* You give new batches 3-4 days of spend before analyzing performance

* You ask for help when something is unclear instead of working around it

* You flag issues to your creative lead immediately, not after the fact











PRACTICAL



* Remote, full time

* Direct collaboration with editing team, media buying, and operations

* Tools: Meta ad account, ClickUp, Google Docs, Figma, Slack

* Access to: customer reviews, post-purchase survey data, angle research briefs, winning ad performance data











SCREENING



1. Share your portfolio. Walk us through three of your best-performing creatives: what was the angle, what was working about it, and what spend did it take?

2. Describe one angle where you developed multiple winning concepts. How did you iterate on it?

3. Show us your research process. How would you approach finding a new angle in the supplement space, specifically around habit breaking?

4. What's your current workload and availability?

5. Walk us through your thinking on one winner: why did you believe it would work before you tested it?

6. Why does this mission matter to you? What's your connection to habit breaking or behavior change?











HOW TO APPLY



DM with:

* Your portfolio

* A few of your best-performing creatives + spend/results

* The thinking behind one of those winners

* Current workload and clients

* Why this mission resonates with you

* Anything else you think we should know



We're open to trial periods and letting results d
 how far we take it.

title: DTC SUPPLEMENT BRAND — VIDEO EDITOR
description:
THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE.



We're looking for someone with years of experience behind them who wants to try something new. If you're early in your career or looking to learn on the job, this isn't the right fit. We need someone who already knows how to do this work and is ready to apply it to a mission they believe in.



ABOUT US



We're a mission-driven health supplement startup focused on habit breaking. We're on pace to do $1M+ per month within the first 90 days. We're building a brand that solves real problems for people who want to change their behavior and break destructive cycles. We're systematized: locked prompting workflows, proven AI animation templates, and fast feedback loops. Your job is to turn a strategist's script and a sample video into finished ads that ship clean and move people toward change.



YOUR ROLE



We want a video editor who shares our mission and can turn a strategist's script plus a sample video into a finished, performance-ready ad. You're not waiting weeks for feedback. You have direct access to strategists, clear revision paths, and concepts that ship every 2-3 days. Every scene is the same two moves: build a first frame, animate that frame.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. FIRST FRAME GENERATION (GPT image generation)

2. ANIMATION PROMPTING & GENERATION (Omni via Google Flow or Seedance 2.5 via Kie AI)

3. VOICEOVER PRODUCTION (ElevenLabs)

4. QC & ASSEMBLY







WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required



* You've personally generated AI video using Omni or a similar image-to-video tool, end to end

* You understand prompt engineering for video generation: dialogue formatting, emotional direction, physical beats, framing locks

* You can QC your own output: you catch spelling mistakes, lip sync drift, character inconsistency, framing creep before you deliver

* You know the difference between regenerating and repairing in post—and you regenerate

* You're familiar with GPT image generation and can iterate on avatar prompts

* 9:16 vertical video native, not adapted

* Reliable overlap with North American hours

* Mission alignment: you believe in helping people break habits and change behavior



Strongly preferred



* Experience with Seedance 2.5 or similar long-form video generation (20-30 seconds in one clip)

* Google Flow or other Omni-based workflows

* ElevenLabs voiceover generation at scale

* Familiarity with animation rule sets: locked framing, multiple physical beats, vocal arcs

* Experience with Kie AI











HOW YOU WORK



* Scene breaks and shot decisions are yours. You watch the sample, read the script, and d
 where the frame changes.

* You verify every clip against a QC checklist before you deliver to QC—spelling, framing holds, character consistency, lip sync, monotone stretches.

* If a clip needs more than a couple of regenerations, you flag it instead of burning credits silently.

* You deliver into QC with a video link, not into review. You never move a task into review yourself.

* You read revision notes, make the change, and resubmit the same path. If you disagree, you say so in the task.

* You ask one focused question when something is genuinely missing (script, avatar description, duration). You don't guess.











PRACTICAL



* Part time, remote

* Overlap with North American hours required

* Tools: Google Flow, Kie AI, GPT image generation, ElevenLabs, ClickUp, Slack

* We provide: Kie AI company account (pre-topped with credits), Google Flow accounts (being provisioned)

* You provide: ElevenLabs account (billed to us on your invoice at end of batch with receipt)

* Cost discipline: generations run $15-30 per concept. Only start generating once the script is final.











SCREENING



1. Share your portfolio. Walk us through one concept where you built the avatar in GPT image generation, animated it in Omni (or similar), and added voiceover. What did you iterate on?

2. Show us one first-frame avatar you generated in your portfolio. What was the brand, and what were you going for in the look?

3. Which of these have you done yourself: locked framing in an animation prompt, added multiple physical beats to direction, written a vocal arc across emotional states? List only what you've done.

4. Describe your QC process. What do you check before you hand off a finished video?

5. What's your time zone, and what hours can you reliably overlap with North America?

6. Why does this mission matter to you? What's your connection to habit breaking or behavior change?











HOW TO APPLY



You must include your favorite color + Video Editor in the subject line of your application for it to be considered. This shows you actually read it and is very important. If it's not in there, your application will be skipped.



DM with:

* Your portfolio

* One concept where you did all three: generated the avatar, animated it, and added voiceover

* A screenshot of a first-frame avatar you generated

* Which animation rules you've implemented yourself

* Your time zone and available hours

* Why this mission resonates with you

* Anything else you think we should know



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Video Editor – Social Media & Reels
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a talented and reliable Video Editor to join our team on a part-time, long-term basis and create high-quality video content for Shym Saunas, an Australian premium sauna brand.



The main focus of this role will be editing Instagram Reels,
 videos, short-form social content, product videos, promotional videos and other brand content using our existing video library and new footage.



We are looking for someone who understands that good social content is not simply about adding transitions and effects. You should have a strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, music, visual flow and audience retention, while maintaining a premium and authentic brand feel.



What You'll Do



Edit short-form videos and Reels for Instagram and
.

Turn raw footage into engaging social media content.

Create different edits from existing video footage where appropriate.

Select strong hooks, opening shots and sequences to capture attention.

Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects and simple motion graphics where appropriate.

Edit product-focused videos while maintaining accurate representation of the actual products.

Create promotional and campaign videos for product launches, sales and seasonal campaigns.

Work with existing footage from our video library and organise/select the best clips for editing.

Follow creative direction and brand guidelines.

Make revisions based on feedback.

Export videos correctly for Instagram,
 and other social platforms.



What We're Looking For



Proven experience as a video editor, particularly for social media/Reels/short-form content.

Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality editing.

Good understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling and audience retention.

Experience creating content for brands, ecommerce or lifestyle businesses is highly desirable.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow a creative brief and take feedback well.

Good English communication skills.

Reliable and able to meet agreed deadlines.

Good eye for premium, natural and authentic visual content.



Very Important – Product Accuracy



Shym Saunas sells premium products, so accuracy is extremely important.



You must not alter, invent or incorrectly represent product features, product configurations or product details when editing videos. We will provide the correct product footage and references, and you will be expected to work carefully with the supplied material.



We also want our content to feel authentic and premium rather than obviously AI-generated. AI tools can be used to assist your workflow where appropriate, but the final content must look natural and professionally produced.



Software



You should be comfortable working with professional video editing software such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro

CapCut

After Effects or similar motion graphics tools



Experience with Canva and AI-assisted editing tools is a plus, but strong editing ability and creative judgement are more important than the specific software you use.



To Apply



Please include:



A link to your best video editing portfolio.

2–3 examples of Reels/short-form videos you have edited.

Briefly explain what software you use.

Tell us how many hours per week you are available.

Tell us your expected hourly rate.

Tell us about your experience editing content for brands, ecommerce or social media.

If given 30 minutes of raw sauna/product footage, briefly explain how you would d
 which sections should become a 30–60 second Reel.



Please do not send generic portfolio links only. We are particularly interested in seeing your short-form social media work.



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person, with the potential for increased hours and responsibility based on performance.



This approach deliberately puts the product-accuracy requirement prominently in the advert. That's important given Artem's recent feedback about AI-looking creatives and inaccurate product representation.

We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Executive Virtual Assistant to support a growing luxury wedding and events business based in Perth, Western Australia.

You will work directly with the Founder and Creative Director to manage the administrative and operational details behind our weddings, events, proposals and luxury experiences.



## Your key responsibilities

* Monitor and organise business inboxes

* Respond to routine client and supplier
s

* Follow up outstanding information, quotes and confirmations

* Maintain client and supplier records

* Follows tasks through to completion

Strong attention to detail is essential. Our event documents include names, dates, supplier contacts, payment deadlines, guest information and live event timings. This information must be accurate.



## Systems we use



Experience with some of the following will be helpful:



* Gmail and Google Workspace

* Google Drive

* Trello

* Studio Ninja

* TTO or That’s The One

* Calendly

* MailerLite

* Xero



You do not need experience with every system. Training will be provided but you must be confident learning new software. However, you must be proactive.



## Experience required



You should have previous experience as an:



* Executive Virtual Assistant

* Executive Assistant

* Operations Assistant

* Administrative Coordinator

* Project Coordinator

* Event or hospitality administrator



Experience in weddings, events, hospitality, travel or a luxury service business will be highly regarded.



Excellent written and spoken English is required.



## Hours and availability

## How to apply

**Ordinary isn’t in our vocabulary.**

2. Are you available during Perth business hours?

title: Growth Strategist - Meta Ads + Direct Response Copy (Full Time, EST Hours)
description:
Perfect Growth Agency is a digital marketing agency running paid

acquisition for service businesses in North America. We are hiring ONE

full-time Growth Strategist to take ownership of ad performance across

our existing client accounts.



This is a thinking role, not a button-pushing role. You will not be

handed a complete brief and told what to build. You will be given a

client, an account, and a goal, and we expect you to dig in, ask sharp

questions, and come back with a plan.



ABOUT THE SCHEDULE (please read before applying)



This role runs on US Eastern Time, which means working nights in the

Philippines. We would rather be upfront about this than have you find

out in month two. If a night schedule does not work for your life

right now, please skip this one, no hard feelings.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Write the ad copy and the landing page copy. This is a major part of

  the job, not a side duty

- Learn our existing client accounts deeply: their customers, their

  offers, what has been tested, what is working and what is fading

- Report weekly per client. Not a numbers dump, a clear story: what we

  tested, what we learned, what is next

- Propose and run the next moves: new angles, new hooks, new creative,

  budget and structure changes

- Concept the creative, then brief our video editors and AI design

  tools clearly enough that they get it right first time

- Build landing pages using AI tools, and diagnose why a page is not

  converting

- Make the daily Meta ads calls: kill, scale, or iterate



YOU ARE A FIT IF



- You write direct response copy. Not "I can write" but: you

  understand awareness levels, you can take a rough draft or AI output

  and pull it up to a standard, and you can explain what you changed

  and why

- You have 2+ years hands-on Meta ads experience with real budget, and

  can walk through an account you personally ran and defend every

  decision you made

- You have written and built landing pages and understand what makes

  them convert

- You use AI daily as a real part of how you work, not as a novelty

- You ask WHY before HOW. The how you can research and figure out. The

  why you push on

- You communicate clearly in writing and on video



NOT IN THIS ROLE



GoHighLevel builds, video editing, sales calls, client account

management. We have people for those. Your job is thinking, writing,

testing, and performance.



SALARY AND GROWTH



USD 800 to 1000 per month to start, depending on experience.



Reviewed at 3 months with a clear path to USD 1400+ based on results.



Paid on time, every time. Weekends off. This is a long-term role and

we are hiring someone to grow into a lead seat as we scale, not a

short-term contractor.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ANGLE. Applications without it

are not read.



Then send links to 3 to 5 pieces of copy you wrote that actually ran.

Ads still live in the Meta Ad Library, landing pages or sales pages

(the URL is fine even if it has since changed),
s, or your own

portfolio. Public links only, so nothing breaches an NDA. If most of

your work is not public, send what you have and tell us the context.



Then answer these three, briefly:



1. One Meta account you personally ran: the niche, roughly the monthly

   ad spend, and your best result

2. The best performing hook you ever wrote, and why you think it worked

3. Tell us about a campaign you d
 to kill. What did you see, and

   how long did you wait before pulling it?



Short answers are fine. We are reading for how you think, not how much

you write. We read the copy before we read the CV.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short Loom video

walking through one real campaign they ran.

title: Structural Revit / CAD Drafter
description:
We are looking for an experienced Structural Revit / CAD Drafter based in the Philippines to support Australian structural engineering projects.



This is not an entry-level drafting role and is not suitable for candidates whose experience is mainly architectural drafting, residential houses, or simple 2D CAD production.



The successful candidate must have:



Minimum 3 years of direct structural drafting experience on multi-storey or high-rise buildings

Proven experience working on Australian structural engineering projects

Strong hands-on experience with Autodesk Revit Structure

Strong AutoCAD structural drafting capability

Practical experience using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360

Experience producing construction documentation for reinforced concrete buildings

Ability to work independently from engineers' mark-ups, sketches, calculations and design instructions

Good understanding of Australian structural documentation standards and drawing conventions

Ability to coordinate structural models with architectural and services models

Preference will be given to candidates who have worked directly for Australian structural engineering consultancies or outsourcing/BIM companies servicing Australian engineering firms.



Candidates must be able to provide the actual names of Australian projects and companies/consultancies they have worked for or supported. Generic statements such as "worked on Australian projects" will not be sufficient.



Key Responsibilities



The Structural Revit / CAD Drafter will be responsible for producing and maintaining structural models and construction documentation for Australian projects including:



Reinforced concrete apartment buildings

Class 2 residential developments

Mixed-use developments

Multi-storey commercial buildings

High-rise residential towers

Basement structures

Podium structures

Transfer structures

Post-tensioned and reinforced concrete floor systems

Concrete and structural steel elements where required

The role will involve both Revit modelling and detailed structural documentation, rather than modelling for visualisation purposes only.



Detailed Revit Skills Required



Candidates must demonstrate strong working knowledge of Revit Structure, including the following.



Structural Model Creation



Ability to independently model:



Concrete columns

Reinforced concrete walls

Core walls

Blade walls

Basement walls

Retaining walls

Concrete beams

Transfer beams

Band beams

Downstand beams

Upstand beams

Slabs

Suspended slabs

Ground slabs

Transfer slabs

Podium slabs

Ramps

Stairs

Footings

Pad footings

Strip footings

Raft slabs

Pile caps

Piles

Ground beams

Structural steel framing where required

Candidates should understand the difference between simply creating Revit geometry and creating a properly structured engineering BIM model suitable for construction documentation.



Levels, Grids and Model Setup



Must be comfortable with:



Establishing and modifying structural levels

Managing floor-to-floor levels

Structural set-down levels

Basement levels

Transfer levels

Roof levels

Grid creation and management

Grid coordination with architectural models

Managing project coordinates

Shared coordinates

Survey points

Project base points

Linked model positioning

Revit Families



Candidates should have practical experience with:



Loading and managing structural families

Editing family parameters

Type parameters

Instance parameters

Creating simple parametric structural families

Modifying existing structural families

Shared parameters

Nested families where required

Structural framing families

Column families

Foundation families

Annotation families

Detail component families

Title blocks

Tags

The candidate does not need to be a full-time Revit family developer but must be capable of modifying and creating families required for normal structural documentation.



Structural Views and Documentation



Must be able to independently prepare:



General arrangement plans

Structural floor plans

Foundation plans

Basement plans

Column layouts

Wall layouts

Slab layouts

Beam layouts

Transfer level drawings

Roof structural plans

Structural sections

Building sections

Wall sections

Beam sections

Slab sections

Foundation sections

Structural elevations

Construction details

Typical details

Enlarged details

Strong understanding of:



View templates

View ranges

Underlays

Plan regions

Crop regions

Scope boxes

Dependent views

Callouts

Sections

Elevations

Detail views

Drafting views

Annotation and Drawing Production



Must be competent in:



Structural dimensions

Spot elevations

Levels

Tags

Beam tags

Column tags

Wall tags

Slab tags

Foundation tags

Keynotes

Text notes

Leaders

Detail lines

Filled regions

Masking regions

Symbols

Section markers

Detail references

Revision clouds

Revision management

The candidate should be capable of producing clean, readable construction drawings rather than relying on engineers to complete drawing presentation.



Revit Schedules



Experience creating and maintaining schedules including:



Column schedules

Wall schedules

Beam schedules

Slab schedules

Foundation schedules

Structural framing schedules

Material schedules

Element schedules

Quantity schedules where required

Candidates should understand:



Filtering

Sorting

Grouping

Calculated parameters

Formatting schedules

Shared parameters

Schedule templates

Worksharing and Model Management



Strong knowledge of Revit worksharing is required, including:



Central models

Local models

Cloud worksharing

Worksets

Synchronisation

Reload latest

Relinquishing elements

Ownership issues

Model health

Purging

Warnings

Auditing models

Managing linked models

Managing model size and performance

Candidate should understand correct collaborative BIM working practices rather than treating Revit as a standalone desktop drafting program.



BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud Experience



Practical BIM 360 or Autodesk Construction Cloud experience is mandatory.



Candidates should be familiar with:



Autodesk Docs

BIM Collaborate

BIM Collaborate Pro

Cloud-hosted Revit models

Publishing models

Consuming models

Model coordination

Version management

File permissions

Folder structures

Document management

Issue tracking

Mark-ups

Reviews

Uploading and downloading project documentation

Managing linked cloud models

Working with architectural and services models hosted in ACC

Candidates should be comfortable working within a live Australian project's ACC environment.



Revit Coordination



Candidates must understand multidisciplinary coordination between:



Structural

Architectural

Mechanical

Electrical

Hydraulic

Fire

Facade

Civil models

Typical responsibilities include:



Linking architectural models

Linking services models

Checking grid alignment

Checking level alignment

Identifying penetrations

Identifying clashes

Reviewing slab penetrations

Reviewing wall openings

Reviewing services risers

Coordinating stairs and cores

Coordinating facade interfaces

Reviewing structural zones against architectural requirements

Experience using Navisworks or ACC Model Coordination is advantageous.



Structural Drawing Knowledge



The candidate must understand typical Australian structural drawings and terminology including:



RLs

FFL

SSL

TOS

TOB

U/S

NGL

slab thicknesses

slab set-downs

step-downs

rebates

penetrations

cast-ins

construction joints

movement joints

isolation joints

transfer structures

column transitions

wall transitions

temporary penetrations

pour strips

post-tensioning zones

stressing pockets

conventional reinforcement zones

A strong understanding of reinforced concrete building construction is highly desirable.



Australian Project Experience – Mandatory



The candidate must have worked on Australian structural engineering projects.



During the application and interview process, candidates will be required to identify:



Name of Australian structural engineering consultancy they worked for or supported

Name of Australian builder/developer where relevant

Actual project names

Project location

Building type

Number of storeys

Their specific responsibilities

Revit version used

Whether the model was hosted in BIM 360 / ACC

Whether they produced construction documentation themselves

Whether they worked directly with Australian engineers

Example:



Project: ABC Residences, Parramatta NSW

Building: 28-storey reinforced concrete residential tower + 4 basement levels

Consultant: XYZ Structural Engineers

Role: Structural Revit Drafter

Responsibilities: Structural modelling, GA plans, slab plans, beam layouts, column/wall layouts, sections and coordination using BIM 360.



Candidates unable to provide specific project examples may not progress to interview.



Minimum Experience



Applicants should have:



Minimum 3 years structural Revit experience

Minimum 3 years experience working on multi-storey/high-rise projects

Demonstrated Australian project experience

Strong reinforced concrete documentation experience

Advanced Revit Structure skills

Strong AutoCAD skills

BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud experience

Experience working from engineering mark-ups

Experience coordinating with architects

Experience dealing with drawing revisions and construction-stage changes

Candidates with 5+ years experience will be highly regarded.



AutoCAD Requirements



The candidate should also be proficient in AutoCAD including:



Structural detailing

Xrefs

Layer management

Blocks

Dynamic blocks

Paperspace

Modelspace

Viewports

CTB/STB plotting

Drawing standards

External references

Revision management

PDF mark-up incorporation

Converting and cleaning consultant CAD backgrounds

Preferred Additional Skills



Highly regarded skills include:



Navisworks

Bluebeam

Revizto

Dynamo

BIM interoperability

Revit model auditing

Revit model optimisation

Revit standards/template development

Reinforcement modelling

Post-tensioning documentation

Structural steel detailing

Clash detection

ISO 19650 familiarity

Australian BIM standards

Autodesk Desktop Connector

Communication Requirements



The successful candidate must be able to:



Read and understand written engineering instructions in English

Understand Australian engineering terminology

Communicate clearly through Teams, Slack,
 or project management systems

Raise RFIs when information is unclear

Identify inconsistencies between architectural and structural documentation

Explain drafting/model coordination issues clearly

Work directly with Australian engineers and project managers

Strong spoken English is preferred, but technical comprehension, written communication and reliability are more important than accent.



Candidate Portfolio Requirements



Every shortlisted candidate must provide a portfolio containing examples of actual structural documentation they have personally worked on.



Preferred examples include:



High-rise structural GA plans

Slab plans

Beam layouts

Column and wall layouts

Foundation plans

Transfer structure drawings

Structural sections

Reinforced concrete details

Revit screenshots

3D structural model screenshots

ACC/BIM 360 project experience

Confidential information may be redacted.



We are more interested in seeing the complexity and quality of the candidate's actual structural work than highly polished portfolio graphics.

title: HR Specialist - CS Recruitment & People Operations (Clark, Office-based)
description:
Full job description

About HK 24-BPO



HK 24-BPO is a fast-growing customer service outsourcing company serving cross-border e-commerce brands. We partner with Amazon and Shopify sellers across smart electronics, smart home, wearables, and audio product categories. Backed by our proprietary AI + human customer service system, we deliver reliable, high-quality support to customers around the world. We are now expanding our team and looking for a dedicated HR Specialist to join us in Clark.



About the Job



We are hiring an office-based HR Specialist in Clark, Pampanga. This is not a remote position — you will work from our office and play a key role in managing the full recruitment cycle and daily HR operations for our growing customer service team.



What You'll Do:



- Source, screen, and recruit customer service representatives across multiple channels (OnlineJobs.ph, referrals, social media, etc.)

- Manage the end-to-end hiring process — from posting job ads to scheduling interviews and onboarding new hires

- Maintain employee records, attendance tracking, and performance documentation

- Handle day-to-day HR administrative tasks and employee relations

- Coordinate with the management team in China to align hiring priorities and timelines

- Support training coordination and new hire orientation

- Build and maintain a talent pipeline for ongoing hiring needs

What You Bring:



- 1–2 years of experience in HR, recruitment, or talent acquisition

- Experience hiring for customer service or BPO roles is a strong plus

- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, job boards, and communication tools

- Self-driven and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment

- Based in or willing to relocate to Clark, Pampanga

What We Offer:



- Competitive salary: $500 – $600 per month

- Office-based position in Clark — stable, professional work environment

- Clear career growth path — grow into a senior HR role as the team scales

- Be part of a tech-driven company that combines AI with human expertise

- Hands-on experience building a team from the ground up

Availability: Full-time, office-based in Clark. Working hours to be discussed.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Tech & AI Channel
description:
PROFESSIONAL LONG-FORM YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR (TECH)



Hey, I'm Giovanni! I'm looking for a talented long-form video editor to team up with me and grow my YouTube channel, TechGio. If you love clean, premium talking-head content and you're excited about tech and AI, keep reading. I think you're going to like this one!



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



TechGio started as me documenting my own journey into tech sales, then turning around to help other people break in with no experience. I'm an enterprise account executive at a tech company, and that content is still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, and day-in-the-life.



Here's what's exciting right now: the channel is expanding! I'm going deeper into the tech industry and AI (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for people in the industry). On top of that, I'm building my own startup and I'm going to share the founder journey and behind-the-scenes of building a company while working full-time.



So it's tech sales, AI and tech updates, and startup life. All talking-head, all long-form, all real.



I've worked with an editor before and it was a great experience. Now I'm ready to go bigger: more videos, more polish, and one editor who becomes a true long-term partner on this. Not a one-off gig. Someone who grows with the channel and wins when it wins. That's you, hopefully!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film, so you'll get raw talking-head footage (Sony A7 IV), screen recordings, and a short brief for each video with the hook, structure, and the moments I want to hit. From there, you run the edit:



- Trim the raw clips, cut dead air, keep it tight and engaging. Retention is the name of the game.

- On-screen text and captions: callouts, key numbers, lists. Clean, sharp, well-timed. This is a big part of the style.

- Simple, polished animations: diagrams for AI concepts, tool and UI highlights, smooth transitions. Think Jeff Su, not MrBeast.

- Screen recording polish: zooms, cursor highlights, blur anything sensitive.

- Music and sound design that fits the vibe, with clean dialogue audio.

- Color, final export, and organized project files.

- Quick revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually just one round.



Thumbnails are a bonus, paid separately if that's something you do.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited long-form YouTube talking-head content before, ideally for tech, business, or productivity channels, and you have published videos to show for it.

- You're strong in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or something similar, and you can make text and motion look premium.

- You use AI in your workflow.

- You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows in the edit when the editor cares about the content.

- You're fast and reliable. First cuts within 48 hours, and if something's going to slip, you tell me before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- You're hardworking, coachable, and want to keep getting better. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with.

- Fluent English. We'll collaborate on Slack or WhatsApp, mostly async, so clear communication matters.



One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started or if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or event videos. Nothing against that work, it's just not what this role is. I need someone who can hit a high bar from day one.



WHAT YOU GET



This is a partnership, and I want it to be a great one for both of us. Here's what that looks like:



- Steady, consistent work: 8–12 videos a month once we're rolling.

- Rate increases as your work speaks for itself. Good work gets rewarded here, I truly mean that!

- Tools covered. If you need software, plugins, stock music, or assets to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for them.

- Real growth. As the channel and everything around it takes off, there's going to be a lot more to make. You get first look at all of it!

- A real voice. I want your ideas on pacing, hooks, and style. You're a creative partner here, and I'm excited to build this with someone who wants to collaborate, not just take orders.



QUICK FACTS



- Channel: 

- Long-form YouTube only. No Shorts.

- 2–3 videos per week

- $50–$100 per video based on experience and quality (roughly $500–$1,000+ per month)

- Fast turnarounds on edits, ideally within 48 hours

- Paid per video. Long-term.



THE STANDARD



Watch a couple of these before applying so we're on the same page:



- Jeff Su: 
 (the golden example — clean, tight, sharp text, subtle motion, never overdone)

- Liam Ottley: 
 (clear diagrams and callouts that make AI simple)

- Dan Martell: 
 (bold text, strong pacing, premium feel)



And my channel for how previous videos were edited: 



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Mission" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

3. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your usual first-cut turnaround.

4. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way!



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Can't wait to see what you've made and hopefully build something great together!



— Giovanni

title: HubSpot Website & Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
The role in one line



You will own our HubSpot website — keeping it accurate, fast to update, and properly connected to the CRM behind it.



________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



About us



We are an Australian events and professional development company running 10–15 live conferences and summits at any one time, across leadership, public sector, HR, diversity and innovation. Our brands include The Leadership Institute and Konnect Learning.



Our entire web presence runs on HubSpot CMS Hub, and our speaker and delegate data lives in HubSpot CRM. The two are deeply linked, and that link is the heart of this job.



You will work alongside our graphic designer as a two-person team: they create the visuals, you get them live and make sure the data behind them is right.



____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Why this role exists

We add at least 15 new speakers a week across our events. Every one needs a bio, headshot, job title and session detail published to the correct event page. Speakers then send revisions constantly — new headshots, updated titles, changed session times.



There is not a two-day stretch where our website does not need a change.



Right now this work gets bottlenecked. We need someone who owns it, moves fast, and does not need chasing.



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What you will do

Website (the core of the job)



Build new pages in HubSpot CMS from scratch — event pages, speaker pages, landing pages — choosing and arranging modules to suit the content, not just cloning an old page

Publish and update event pages, speaker profiles and agendas

Create and maintain forms, and check they are capturing correctly

Upload graphics supplied by our designer, at the right size and format

Check every page renders properly on desktop and mobile before calling it done

Keep pages consistent — correct job titles, correct session times, no stale content



CRM and the interplay



Understand how website forms, pages and CTAs feed contact records in HubSpot CRM

Keep contact and speaker data clean, correctly associated and properly segmented

Make sure a change on the website is reflected in the CRM, and the reverse



Marketing operations — as you grow into the role



Build marketing
s in HubSpot using existing templates

Set up and maintain workflows for registration confirmations and nurture sequences

Pull basic reporting on page performance, form conversion and
 engagement



Working with the team



Take work from a shared task queue rather than scattered chat messages

Flag blockers early instead of going quiet

Confirm clearly when something is live



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Essential requirements

You must have hands-on HubSpot experience. This is not a role where you can learn HubSpot as you go. Specifically:



HubSpot CMS Hub, at a build level. You can create a genuinely new page — choosing and arranging modules, working with drag-and-drop areas and theme settings — not only clone and edit an existing one. This is the single most important requirement in this ad.

Some HTML and CSS. Enough to adjust a module, fix spacing, or make something behave properly on mobile when the editor alone will not do it.

HubSpot CRM — contacts, properties, associations, lists and segmentation

A real understanding of how the website and the CRM connect — forms, CTAs, tracking and lifecycle stages. We want someone who sees the website and the database as one system, not two.

Strong general website experience beyond HubSpot — you have built or maintained real sites and understand layout, image optimisation and mobile behaviour

Accuracy under volume. This job involves a lot of small changes where details matter.

Speed. We need same-day turnaround on most requests.

Clear written English and reliable, consistent communication

Availability overlapping Australian Eastern Standard Time business hours (roughly 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM PHT). This is non-negotiable — we need to resolve things with you in real time.

Welcome, and where this role grows

We would rather hire someone excellent at the website work who can grow into operations than someone who talks a good game on automation but cannot build a page.



So the following are genuinely optional, and we will support you in developing them:



HubSpot marketing
 builds

HubSpot workflows and automation

Reporting and dashboards

HubSpot custom objects

HubL templating



If you already have some of this, say so — it will count in your favour and shape how quickly the role expands. If you do not, apply anyway provided your CMS and CRM skills are solid.

Also nice to have

HubSpot certifications (CMS Hub, Marketing Hub, Marketing Software)

Basic image editing — cropping and resizing headshots to spec

Experience in events, education or conferences

Familiarity with ClickUp



_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Who this suits

You are meticulous, you like a clear queue of work and clearing it, and you take quiet pride in a site that is always correct. You would rather ask a question than guess. You do not need reminding.



If you enjoy owning a system and keeping it in good order, you will like this role.



____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



The details



Hours: 2–4 hours per day, Monday to Friday, with overlap into Australian business hours

Rate: AUD $8–10 per hour depending on demonstrated HubSpot experience

Type: Ongoing, long-term. We are looking for someone to stay with us.

Growth: This role is designed to grow. Get the website side right and there is scope to take on our wider HubSpot marketing operations, with more hours and a higher rate to match.



________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

How to apply

Please answer all of the following. Applications that do not address the HubSpot questions specifically will not be considered — we need to see real experience, not a general VA application.



How long have you worked in HubSpot, and in what capacity? Name the hubs and tools you have used.

Have you built a brand new page in HubSpot CMS Hub from scratch? Walk us through how you did it — how you chose and arranged the modules, and anything you had to do in HTML or CSS. Include links to live pages if you can. This is the question we care most about.

Explain in your own words how a HubSpot website connects to the HubSpot CRM. We want to understand how you think about it, not a textbook answer.

What other website experience do you have outside HubSpot? Platforms, and examples we can look at.

Give an example of high-volume, detail-heavy work you have handled and how you kept it accurate.

Optional: describe any HubSpot
, workflow or reporting work you have done. If you have none, say so honestly — it will not rule you out.

Your available hours in Philippine time.

Your hourly rate in AUD.

Any HubSpot certifications you hold.



We read every application properly and reply to shortlisted candidates.
