title: Executive Operations Coordinator (Technical Project Lead & Founder Buffer)
description:
I run a multi-brand technology and e-commerce portfolio, including an established online retail operation, automated AI dispatch systems, and an expanding digital agency—Gulf Coast Web Co. 



I operate as the architect and strategist: I move fast, communicate with absolute directness, and value radical precision. I do not micromanage, nor do I have time to hand-hold. 



I am NOT looking for a traditional virtual assistant who asks, "What should I do today, boss?" 



I am hiring an Executive Operations Coordinator (EOC) to serve as my operational air-traffic controller and founder buffer. You will sit directly between me and our technical contractors, GoHighLevel (GHL) developers, and automation engineers. 



Your single governing mandate: Make sure Tony only does work that requires Tony.



---



THE Q4 COMMERCIAL MISSION (YOUR IMMEDIATE BENCHMARK)

We are scaling our streamlined agency model for Gulf Coast Web Co., delivering 5-to-7 page high-converting websites with integrated booking CTAs for local service contractors (pressure washing, marine detailing, tree services, landscaping).



• The Goal: Scale from 0 to 30 active onboarded clients ($49–$59/mo recurring care plans) by November 15, 2026.

• Your Responsibility: Manage the velocity of the pipeline—from lead scraping and mockup production handoffs with our VAs, to quality assurance, client onboarding check-ins, and Stripe subscription activation. You will ensure no prospect falls through the cracks and no contractor stalls.



---



WHAT YOU WILL OWN:

1. Contractor Traffic Control: Direct and hold accountable our specialized GHL engineers, UI builders, and automation contractors across daily sprint checkpoints. Verify contractor deliverables against agreed scopes BEFORE approving milestone payouts. Stop scope creep and unapproved billing dead in its tracks.

2. The Daily Executive Briefing (Bandwidth Protection): Review all contractor progress, bug reports, and project tickets daily. Synthesize 20+ piecemeal developer questions into ONE clean, 150-word morning memo for me covering: (1) Completed Milestones, (2) Active Bottlenecks, and (3) Decisions Tony Needs to Make.

3. Rigorous Quality Assurance (QA): Refuse to accept "It's done" from a developer without proof. You will personally inspect test links, confirm mobile responsiveness, verify form routing, and ensure webhook payloads actually fire. If a system isn’t fully tested, you keep it marked YELLOW.

4. Operations & Pipeline Rhythm: Maintain the master project dashboard, access rosters, and build checklists in Google Sheets/ClickUp. Ensure domain setups, DNS records, and customer onboarding handoffs run cleanly within 48 hours.



---



WHO YOU ARE (THE NON-NEGOTIABLES):

• Assertive with Technical Contractors: You have experience managing software engineers or agency builders. You are confident enough to challenge a developer, verify their Loom walkthroughs, and reject incomplete work.

• GoHighLevel & Systems Literate: You do not need to write raw code, but you must thoroughly understand GHL architecture: sub-accounts, snapshots, custom fields, pipeline stage triggers, native Stripe integration, and basic webhook logic.

• Radical Candor & Thick-Skinned: I communicate directly, concisely, and without corporate fluff. If an operational timeline is unrealistic, or if my direction has a technical flaw, you must be confident and articulate enough to say: "Tony, that approach will break our data layer; here is the better path." You treat direct criticism as operational data, not an emotional event.

• Extreme Ownership: When you are left alone for 48 hours while I focus on higher-level strategy, you do not sit idle. You drive the daily contractor rhythm, enforce deadlines, audit pipelines, and keep the mission moving.



---



HOW TO APPLY (MANDATORY INSTRUCTIONS - INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL BE DISCARDED):

1. Subject Line: Air-Traffic Controller — [Your City, Your Full Name]

2. Attach your updated CV/Resume highlighting your experience with marketing agencies, project management, and GoHighLevel.

3. Provide a link to a 2-to-3 minute Loom video (camera on) directly addressing these three questions:

   • Question 1: Give a specific example of a time you had to reject a technical contractor’s work because they claimed it was "done," but it didn't meet quality or test standards.

   • Question 2: How do you manage working closely with a high-conviction, fast-moving founder who has zero patience for fluff or excuses?

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: Competitive

To apply: Details at the bottom of the page



Most supply chains at small brands run on hope. Someone places an order, assumes the supplier is on track, and finds out otherwise when stock runs out or a shipment arrives wrong.



That's not how Säker operates.



We run a methodical supply chain across three markets: US, Canada, and EU; with multiple suppliers, freight forwarders, and receiving warehouses moving simultaneously. The person in this role is the connective tissue. They make sure suppliers know what's expected, freight forwarders have what they need, warehouses are ready to receive, and nothing falls through the cracks between any of them.



It's coordination work, and it matters. When it's done well, inventory flows and nobody notices. When it isn't, everything stops.

If keeping complex operations quietly on track sounds like the kind of work you're good at, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Supplier Coordination



Keeping suppliers on schedule; confirming production timelines, following up on open orders, collecting documentation, and making sure nothing is missing before a shipment moves.



Freight and Logistics Coordination



Working with freight forwarders across air and sea lanes to book shipments, track movement, and flag delays before they become problems. Keeping all parties: suppliers, forwarders, and warehouses; aligned at every handoff.



Warehouse Receiving Coordination



Making sure receiving warehouses have what they need ahead of every inbound shipment. Confirming quantities, labels, and documentation are correct before goods arrive.



Compliance and QC Documentation

Collecting and filing test certificates, inspection reports, and supplier compliance documents. Coordinating third-party inspection scheduling and following up on findings.



Administrative and Operational Support



Maintaining purchase order records, updating inventory trackers, and keeping internal files organized. The behind-the-scenes work that keeps everything else running cleanly.



HOW YOU'LL WORK



You'll report directly to the Supply Chain & Inventory Planner. Direction comes from the Planner, with visibility to the founder on key operational decisions.



Turnaround varies by task. Supplier follow-ups and shipment coordination move fast. Compliance documentation and PO administration move on longer timelines and require careful follow-through.



You'll work primarily in Prediko, Sellerboard, Amazon Seller Central, and Google Workspace, with tasks tracked in ClickUp.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 



Shipments arrive on time, in full, and without surprises. Suppliers are followed up before anyone has to ask. Documentation is filed before it's needed. Warehouses are ready before goods arrive.



The Inventory Planner spends less time on coordination and more time on planning. Nothing slips; not because someone caught it at the last minute, but because the system is being maintained well enough that last-minute catches aren't necessary.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 



1–3 years in supply chain, procurement, or operations — consumer goods or e-commerce preferred

Strong organizational skills and comfortable managing multiple open items across suppliers, timelines, and channels

Clear written communicator in English; confident following up with external partners

Comfortable working independently and figuring things out before asking

Proficient in Google Workspace and Excel



BONUS POINTS



Experience with Amazon FBA, freight logistics, or third-party QC inspections

Familiarity with Prediko, Sellerboard, or similar tools

Background in apparel, outdoor, or consumer goods



WHAT WE OFFER



Real operational scope from day one: suppliers, freight, warehouses, and compliance all in one role

A fast feedback loop with the Inventory Planner and founder, not layers of approval

High standards, low politics, clear direction

A brand with a real point of view, not another pet company chasing cuteness

Competitive compensation and room to grow as the brand scales

The chance to build something you can actually point to



LOCATION AND WORK STYLE



This role is fully remote. Compensation is competitive and based on experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send an
 to 
 with:

A short introduction

Your portfolio

One project you're proud of, and why



Use the subject line: Supply Chain Coordinator - Your Name



We care more about how you think than how your resume looks.

# Administration & Artist Support Assistant



**YoYo Management / YoYo Music**



We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and digitally savvy **Administration & Artist Support Assistant** to work across our artist management and music business.



This is a varied role suited to someone who loves organisation, is comfortable working independently and can bring structure to a fast-moving creative business. You will work across multiple artists and projects, helping us keep information, promotional materials, photographs, documents and day-to-day administration organised and up to date.



A major initial focus of the role will be helping us **reorganise and streamline our digital filing systems and artist assets**, followed by taking responsibility for keeping those systems organised going forward.



## Key Responsibilities



### Artist Files, Photos & Promotional Assets



* Reorganise and maintain digital folders for each of our artists.

* Sort and catalogue artist photographs, press shots, live images, artwork, logos, videos and other promotional assets.

* Ensure current and approved images and materials are clearly identified and easy for the team to access.

* Archive outdated photographs, artwork and promotional materials.

* Maintain organised folders for press kits, biographies, press releases, tour assets, social media content and other artist materials.

* Ensure files are consistently and sensibly named so that information can be found quickly.

* Help identify duplicate, missing or outdated files and clean up existing folder structures.

* Maintain current versions of artist biographies, EPK materials, promotional photographs and other commonly requested assets.



### General Administration



* Provide day-to-day administrative support across the business.

* Organise and maintain company files, documents and records.

* Assist with
 administration and follow-ups where required.

* Keep contact databases, mailing lists and industry contacts organised and up to date.

* Assist with calendars, appointments, meetings and scheduling.

* Prepare and organise documents, spreadsheets and information for meetings.

* Follow up outstanding information, documents and approvals.

* Assist with invoices, receipts and basic accounts administration where required.

* Help maintain templates and systems for frequently used documents and processes.



### Artist & Project Support



* Assist management with administration relating to releases, touring, promotion and artist projects.

* Keep track of deadlines, deliverables and outstanding tasks across different artists.

* Organise information relating to releases, press, marketing, touring and promotional campaigns.

* Assist with tour administration including itineraries, accommodation information, travel documents and schedules when required.

* Help prepare and distribute promotional materials to labels, publishers, agents, promoters, media and other industry partners.

* Keep artist information and key documents current and readily accessible.



### Systems & Organisation



We are particularly looking for someone who can look at the way we currently organise information and **help us make it better**.



This will include:



* Reviewing our existing Google Drive/Dropbox/shared folder structures.

* Creating logical and consistent filing systems across all artists.

* Developing simple naming conventions and folder structures.

* Creating master folders and templates that can be replicated for new artists and projects.

* Making sure important information isn't sitting in random
s, downloads folders or individual computers.

* Helping establish straightforward administrative processes that the whole team can follow.

* Maintaining those systems once they have been established.



## About You

title: Freight Operations & Load Planning Specialist - US Trucking Dispatch (Freight Experience Required)
description:
Moscoso Express is a 20+ year trucking company in the United States specializing in expedited and air freight. We move time-sensitive shipments across the Midwest, and this role is where those shipments get planned.



We are hiring Operations Support Specialists who already know freight. This is not an entry-level tracking or customer service role. You will plan and route orders, choose equipment, set appointments, and manage exceptions for a fleet that runs 24 hours a day. Please read the requirements carefully. We ask for a video and for details of your freight background and education, and we do not review applications that leave any of them out.



What you will do:

- Plan and route incoming orders: pickup and delivery windows, transit time, driver hours, and equipment (dry van, straight truck, sprinter, team vs solo)

- D
 how each load runs: drop trailer or live load, appointment type, and sequencing when several orders overlap

- Work across multiple US time zones at once and convert between them accurately

- Coordinate with drivers, customers, and internal team members by phone and in writing

- Monitor loads and give status updates before they are asked for

- Resolve delays, weather, breakdowns, schedule changes, and pickup or delivery exceptions, and escalate with a clear summary and a recommended next step

- Keep order records, shipment updates, and communications accurate and current

- Work across a TMS, GPS tracking, spreadsheets,
, Slack, and customer portals



Freight experience is required:

This is the first thing we look at, so we want to be clear about it up front. We are looking for people who have worked in trucking or freight forwarding and have hands-on experience with several of the following: carriers and drivers, load planning or dispatch, FTL and LTL, a TMS (McLeod, Aljex, Ascend, Priority1, or similar), load boards (DAT, Truckstop), BOL, POD, and rate confirmations, track and trace, or forwarding operations.

If your background is customer service, general virtual assistant work, ecommerce order tracking, warehouse-only, or BPO without freight, this role will not be the right fit, even if a past job title included "dispatch" or "logistics". We mention this so you can spend your time on roles that match your experience.



Education:

Freight planning is problem-solving with numbers, time, and distance, so we look for candidates whose studies built those skills. Engineering (industrial, mechanical, civil, or similar), logistics, supply chain management, transportation, or another science, technology, or math field is a strong match. Please tell us your degree or course and your school in your application.



What we have learned about this role:

We have trained several people in this role, and the ones who did well shared a few habits. We share them here so you can d
 whether this sounds like you.

- You like to drive your own work. You start the next order, look ahead, and bring questions early rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

- You read carefully. Our instructions are written, detailed, and in English, and you are comfortable reading them fully and applying them on your own.

- You take feedback on board. When we adjust something, the next order shows the change.

- You keep a good pace. A fully planned order should take about 15 to 20 minutes, and you will often plan several at once. Speed and accuracy both matter.

- You speak up. If you are blocked, confused, or behind, you say so in Slack right away. We would much rather hear about a problem early than find it later.

- You can explain your thinking. You can write a short, clear summary of what you did on an order and why you chose that plan.



Working hours:

Training runs on a fixed schedule in US Central Time, which we will confirm with you before you start. Your regular schedule is assigned during training.

- Initial training: 2 weeks, Monday to Friday, on a fixed daily schedule in US Central Time. Please only apply if you can commit to all 10 training days.

- Ongoing coaching continues through your first 3 months, alongside your regular shift.

- After initial training: we operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, so regular schedules vary and may include weekend hours. Your shift is set with you during training.

- All schedules are set in US Central Time, so your Philippine local hours and days will not match ours. A US daytime shift falls overnight in the Philippines, and a US evening shift falls during Philippine daytime. Philippine times shift one hour later when US daylight saving time ends in November.



Working arrangement and pay:

- The rate for this role is $9 - $11 USD per hour, based on your experience. At 40 hours per week, that is about $1,560 - $1,900 USD per month.

- This is an independent contractor position, not employment. You are responsible for your own taxes and government contributions in the Philippines.

- Training is also a trial period, for you as much as for us. It is a chance for both sides to see whether the role and the schedule are a good fit. During this period we are not able to promise work for any set length of time, and either side may d
 at any point that it is not the right match. We will be straightforward with you about how things are going, and we hope you will be just as open with us. If it is working well, we would very much like you to stay with us long term.

- Pay is sent twice a month.

- We use TimeProof for time tracking. You install the free TimeProof app from OnlineJobs.ph and sign in with your OnlineJobs.ph account. It records your working time and takes periodic screenshots of your screen while you are on shift. Your pay is based on this record. Please only apply if you are comfortable with screenshot-based time tracking.



Home office requirements (required, and checked during training):

- Two monitors or more. One screen is not workable for this role.

- A headset with a microphone for calls with drivers and customers

- Stable, fast internet and reliable power. A backup internet option is not required but is preferred.

- A quiet workspace and a computer that runs several browser tabs, a TMS, and Slack at once without slowing down



How to apply:

Your application must include all three parts. Applications missing any of them are not reviewed.

1. A 1-2 minute video, in English, introducing yourself and describing one specific load or shipment you planned or handled: what the freight was, what decisions you made, and what went right or wrong. Use any of these:

- Loom (
) - free, records you and your screen in the browser, gives you a link instantly

- YouTube - upload and set the video to "Unlisted"

- Google Drive - upload and set sharing to "Anyone with the link"

Open your link in a private/incognito window first to confirm it plays for someone outside your account.

2. Your freight background: the companies, your role, how long, and which of the systems and tasks above you used.

3. Your education: degree or course, and school.



We look forward to hearing from you.

Preparing and submitting Medicare Part B claims

Claim creation and submission

Claim tracking

Rejections and denials

ERA/payment posting

Patient accounts



*If you have strong Medicare billing experience using another EHR but are comfortable learning CharmHealth, I am still interested in hearing from you.*



*Experience with GoHighLevel is highly preferred.*

I use GoHighLevel for patient invoicing, recurring payments, and other patient payment workflows.

This is NOT primarily a social media or marketing position.

Experience with Canva, newsletters, social media, content creation, or digital marketing is a bonus, but billing, bookkeeping, and financial organization are the priority.



YOU WOULD BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Understand the claims process from submission through payment

Have strong attention to detail

Follow through until problems are actually resolved

Understand the importance of patient confidentiality

Are reliable and consistent

Want a long-term position with a growing medical practice



YOU ARE PROBABLY NOT A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

Have healthcare VA experience but have never personally submitted insurance claims

Have no Medicare billing experience

Need step-by-step instructions for every task

Frequently leave tasks unfinished without follow-up

Struggle with attention to detail

Are uncomfortable troubleshooting rejected or denied claims

Have difficulty managing multiple small tasks independently

Simply report that something “doesn't work” without attempting to identify the cause or solution



SOFTWARE & EXPERIENCE

Required:

Medicare Part B billing experience

Healthcare/medical office experience

QuickBooks Online



Strongly Preferred:

CharmHealth / CharmEHR

GoHighLevel



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Reliable computer

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:

Why strong setters join us

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: Bookkeeper Australia/ USA
description:
# Part-Time Bookkeeper – Music Industry



**20 hours per week | Remote / Flexible**



We are looking for an experienced and highly organised **Bookkeeper** to work approximately **20 hours per week**, supporting a group of businesses operating across **Australia and the United States within the music and entertainment industry**.



This role would suit someone who is confident working independently, is extremely detail-oriented, and has strong hands-on experience with **both Xero and QuickBooks**.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records across multiple entities and will need to be comfortable working with different currencies, jurisdictions, bank accounts and business structures.



## Key Responsibilities



* Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple Australian and US entities

* Maintain accounts using **Xero and QuickBooks**

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and payment platforms

* Process and categorise income and expenses accurately

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

* Enter and reconcile supplier invoices and payments

* Maintain accurate records of artist, touring, production and business expenses

* Track payments to artists, contractors, suppliers and other service providers

* Assist with payroll and contractor payments where required

* Maintain supporting documentation, invoices and receipts

* Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations

* Assist with multi-currency transactions and reconciliations

* Prepare regular financial reports for management

* Maintain clean and accurate balance sheets and general ledgers

* Work with external accountants and tax advisers in both Australia and the US

* Prepare bookkeeping records and supporting information for BAS, GST, sales tax, payroll and other statutory reporting as required

* Assist with year-end preparation and provide information requested by accountants

* Identify discrepancies or unusual transactions and proactively follow them up

* Help improve bookkeeping systems, processes and financial controls across the businesses



## About You



You will ideally have:



* Strong professional bookkeeping experience

* **Excellent working knowledge of both Xero and QuickBooks**

* Experience managing the books for **multiple companies or entities**

* Experience working with businesses operating in **Australia and the United States**

* A good understanding of Australian bookkeeping requirements, including GST and BAS

* Familiarity with US bookkeeping and accounting processes

* Experience with multi-currency accounts and international transactions

* Strong bank and credit-card reconciliation skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* The ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines

* Strong communication skills and the confidence to follow up when information is missing

* A high level of discretion when dealing with confidential financial information



Experience in the **music, entertainment, touring, events or creative industries** would be highly regarded.



## The Role



This is a **part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week**.



There is flexibility around how the hours are structured, however we are looking for someone who can be consistently available throughout the week rather than completing all hours in one block.



The role will involve working closely with the business owners and external accountants in Australia and the United States.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply enter transactions, but who takes **ownership of the books** — keeping accounts current, spotting issues, chasing missing information and making sure the financial records across all entities remain accurate and organised.



## To Apply



Please provide:



* A brief summary of your bookkeeping experience

* Your experience using **Xero and QuickBooks**

* Details of any experience working with Australian and US companies

* Any experience within music, entertainment or other creative industries

* Your availability

* Your hourly rate

* Your location and time zone



We are looking for someone reliable and experienced who is interested in developing a long-term working relationship with the business.

title: Video Editor & Social Content Creator — Reels, Ads & Storytelling (AI-Assisted, Part-Time)
description:
Job overview



Video Editor & Social Content Creator  |  Part-Time 20–30+ hours/week  |  Remote – Philippines  |  Long-term



We're looking for someone who gets it.



Let's be direct about what we want, because it matters more than any software list.

We want a video editor who can be handed a brand, an audience and a goal — and come back with something better than we'd have thought to ask for. Someone who watches a raw clip and sees the story in it. Someone who sends us an idea we hadn't considered.



What we don't want is someone who needs to be told what to make, shot by shot. We've had that, and it costs us more time than doing it ourselves.



If you're the kind of editor who has opinions about hooks, who notices when an ad isn't working and says why, and who'd rather pitch three concepts than wait for a brief — keep reading.



The role



You'll create short-form video across three Australian brands: concept, hook, script and edit. Not just assembly — you own the idea.



The Leadership Institute — B2B. We run 10–15 live conferences and leadership summits across Australia and New Zealand. Corporate, professional, credible. Think speaker highlights, event promos, thought-leadership clips, LinkedIn content that earns attention from senior executives.



Prism & Pearl (prismandpearl.store) — B2C eCommerce. Luxury moissanite and sterling silver jewellery. Premium, elegant, understated. Product-led reels and paid social that sell without shouting.



Brio & Bloom (
) — B2C eCommerce. Sensory toys and comfort products for children with diverse needs. Warm, calm, reassuring, aimed at parents. Newly launched, so there's real scope to shape how it looks and sounds.

You'll be working across Meta 
 and Instagram), TikTok and LinkedIn — organic reels and paid ads.



What you'll be working with



You'll get a genuine mix of source material, and part of the skill is knowing what to do with each:

● Raw conference and event footage we film at our summits — speaker sessions, audience moments, venue atmosphere

● Product video for the two eCommerce brands

● Stills, stock and licensed footage to build from where there's no video

● AI-generated video, where it makes sense



Some pieces will be cut from hours of event footage. Others you'll build from almost nothing. Being comfortable with both is important.



Being able to move between those registers is essential. A LinkedIn clip for executives and a jewellery ad and a gentle piece for parents of neurodivergent kids are three completely different jobs. One signature style won't work here.



What we need from you



Storytelling first. You can find and tell a story in 15 seconds, and communicate a value proposition without it feeling like an ad read.



Genuine autonomy. You take a goal and run with it. You suggest things nobody asked for. You flag when something isn't working. We don't want to art-direct every cut.



Real editing craft. Pacing, rhythm, timing, captions, sound. AI helps you go faster — it doesn't do this part for you.

AI as a serious tool. You use AI in your workflow and you're across what's available. If you're using platforms we haven't thought of, tell us — we want to learn from you.



To be clear: this is not a prompt engineering role. We need a real editor who uses AI to work faster and better, not someone whose only skill is generating clips. If you can produce AI footage but couldn't fix the pacing of a cut or explain why a hook isn't landing, this isn't for you.



Quality over quantity. We're not asking for a content factory — a few strong pieces a week, done properly. We would rather have three reels that work than ten that don't.



Excellent written English. You'll be writing hooks, captions and on-screen copy for an Australian audience. Captions go on every video — most social is watched with the sound off, and they need to be accurate and well-timed. Using AI to speed this up is encouraged, as long as you check it.



Music and licensing sense. You'll source your own tracks, with our input. Most of this work is paid Meta advertising, so you need to understand what's safe to use in an ad versus what's fine on an organic post. Getting this wrong gets ads rejected.

Commercial understanding. You know the difference between B2B and eCommerce marketing, and why an ad that works for one would fail for the other.



Practical requirements



● Your own editing software and AI platforms. We're not precious about which — CapCut and Canva are perfectly fine if that's how you get great results. Premiere Pro and After Effects are welcome but not required. We care about the finished piece, not the tool.

● Reliable high-speed internet

● Available within 10:00am–6:00pm AEST/AEDT (8:00am–4:00pm Philippine time; 7:00am–3:00pm from October when Sydney moves to daylight saving)

Nice to have: experience with events or conferences; motion graphics; experience running or editing paid social campaigns.



How we'll work together at the start



We'll review and give feedback on your first 5–10 pieces — our Marketing Manager and leadership team. This isn't micromanagement; it's how we get aligned on what good looks like for each brand.



Once we're confident in your work, you'll run with it. The goal is for you to work independently, and we'll get there quickly if you take feedback well. If you're looking for a role where someone directs every cut indefinitely, we're not it — but we won't drop you in cold either.



Hours, salary and terms



● Hours: 20–30+ per week, producing a few finished pieces weekly

● Salary: AUD $800–$1,400 per month (approximately PHP 37,000–63,000 at current rates), depending on demonstrated experience

● Type: Long-term and ongoing. We want someone to stay.

● Start date: We're looking for someone to begin within the next two weeks, so please tell us your earliest availability.





How to apply



A broad portfolio is essential. Applications without one won't be considered.

We want to see range, not just your best single piece. Include B2B and B2C work if you have both, and paid social alongside organic if you can.



Please answer these:

1. Your portfolio. Show us reels, short-form ads and social video across different brands and audiences.

2. Pick one of our three brands, look at what they're currently doing, and pitch us a reel concept. A few sentences is plenty — the hook, the story, why it would work for that audience. This is the question we care most about. We're not looking for a polished proposal; we want to see how you think when nobody's briefing you.

3. Tell us about a time you improved a project beyond what was asked. What did you suggest, and what happened?

4. How do you use AI in your video work? Which platforms, at what point in your process, and what you still do yourself. If you're using something we probably haven't heard of, tell us about it.

5. Which editing software you use, and your setup. Any tool is fine — we just want to know how you work.

6. Your available hours in Philippine time, and confirmation you can work within our window.

7. Your expected monthly salary in AUD, and the hours per week that reflects.

8. Your earliest start date.

We read every application properly and reply to shortlisted candidates.

title: Video Editor for Social Media Agency - Full-Time Only
description:
Jeong X is a social + content agency that builds and runs “money models” for expert, education, and news brands. Our clients are serious operators who publish a lot of content and care about real business results, not vanity metrics.



We’re hiring a full‑time Video Editor to join our remote team.

This is a production-heavy editing role: you’ll be cutting YouTube videos, short‑form clips (Reels/TikTok/Shorts), and simple graphics‑heavy pieces using our templates and SOPs. The most important traits are: you learn fast, you don’t repeat the same mistake twice, and you communicate clearly.



APPLY HERE: 



What you’ll do

You will:

* Edit short‑form videos (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) from talking‑head or news clips:

    * Cut for pace and retention.

    * Add captions, simple graphics, b‑roll, music, and sound effects using our templates.

* Edit long‑form videos (YouTube, podcasts, educational / documentary content) based on scripts and story outlines.

* Follow brand guidelines and SOPs for each client:

    * Fonts, colors, layouts, pacing rules, thumbnails (when needed).

* Collaborate with social media managers, motion designers, and other editors:

    * Take feedback, apply notes quickly, and update future edits based on what you’ve learned.

* Prepare clean exports and organized project files for review and publishing.



This role is not about crazy VFX or advanced 3D. We care most about strong storytelling, pacing, and clean execution at volume.



What success looks like (first 90 days)

By month 3, you:

* Consistently deliver multiple edits per day at our quality bar.

* Rarely repeat the same mistake twice once it has been documented.

* Maintain a high “clean pass” rate (most edits approved with minimal changes).

* Communicate proactively about progress, blockers, and deadlines.

* Can take a new client’s SOP and match their style quickly without constant supervision.



Must‑have

* Strong experience editing for YouTube and/or social video (send links to your best work).

* Solid sense of pacing, storytelling, and rhythm:

    * You know how to cut out fluff and keep viewers watching.

* Comfortable with basic motion and graphics:

    * Captions, simple transitions, on‑screen text, reframes, zooms.

* Learns fast:

    * You can read a style guide, watch a few examples, and quickly match the look/feel.

* Doesn’t repeat mistakes:

    * When you get feedback, you apply it not just to that edit, but to all future edits.

* Reliable communication:

    * Responds during agreed work hours.

    * Gives daily updates on what’s done, what’s in progress, and what’s stuck.

* Fluent in English - reading, writing, and speaking

* Stable internet and a machine that can handle modern 4K editing workloads.



Nice to have

* Experience editing news, commentary, or documentary‑style content.

* Thumbnail experience (designing or collaborating on concepts).

* Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills.

* Familiarity collaborating with motion designers and following their graphics packs.



Tools you’ll use

* Primary: Adobe Premiere Pro 

* Also helpful: After Effects for simple motion

* Communication via Slack, Notion, and Google Drive.

title: Social Media Manager for Content Agency
description:

We specialize in transforming social feeds into growth engines, consistently driving 50%+ reach increases in the first 90 days. If you love taking full ownership, moving fast, and being judged by results, you’ll fit here.



APPLY HERE: 



About This Role

We’re looking for a performance-driven Social Media Marketing Manager who understands U.S. culture and can manage full channels end to end.

You will:

* Own daily content output across
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

* Coordinate with our editing/design team, not just “post what you’re given.”

* Make decisions from data, not vibes.

* Communicate clearly with founders, clients, and teammates in real time.

You’ve already grown channels before and can prove it with screenshots, dashboards, and clear before/after metrics.



Key Responsibilities

Content & Channel Ownership

* Build and maintain daily content calendars for assigned clients (typically 3-6 posts per platform per day).

* Create video & graphic content to push based on objective of clients (primarily expand reach).

* Turn raw footage, ideas, and existing assets into clear briefs for editors and designers.

* Review and approve edits to ensure hooks, pacing, and CTAs match U.S. audience expectations.

* Publish content on all platforms and ensure nothing breaks the schedule.

Strategy & Analytics

* Set clear growth targets per account (reach, views, subscribers/followers, CTR, watch time).

* Track and report weekly performance to the internal team and clients.

* Identify winners and losers, then update hooks, thumbnails, titles, and topics accordingly.

* Stay current on cultural trends and platform changes, especially for American audiences.

Client & Team Communication

* Give clients simple, honest updates: what we did, what happened, what we’re doing next.

* Translate client feedback into clear tasks for editors/designers.

* Work in a fast-paced, feedback-heavy environment without dropping the ball.



Expected Results (How You’ll Be Measured)

* Growth: 50%+ account-wide reach/views increase within the first 90 days for new clients.

* Consistency: 95%+ on-time posting rate against agreed content calendar.

* Engagement: Rising engagement rates and watch time across key platforms.

* Execution: Clear weekly reports and strategic recommendations for every account you manage.



Requirements

Experience & Skills

* 3+ years managing social media channels with proven growth (YouTube and Instagram required).

* Experience in an agency or multi-brand environment strongly preferred.

* Deep understanding of U.S. audience behavior, storytelling, pacing, and platform nuances.

Technical

* Comfortable editing and adjusting short-form videos (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).

* Strong eye for hooks, thumbnails, titles, and short-form trends.

* Proficiency with Canva/Photoshop and social scheduling/analytics tools.

Communication & Work Style

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Fast, clear communication (primarily WhatsApp and Slack).

* Ability to work aligned with New York time zone.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Comfortable with direct feedback, changing priorities, and high standards.



Portfolio Requirements

* Links to social accounts you’ve managed with before/after growth metrics.

* Short-form video examples (Reels/Shorts/TikToks) aligned with current trends.

* Any case studies or breakdowns of how you improved a channel.



What We Offer

* Full-time role with clear advancement paths as we grow.

* Work with a sharp, global creative and operations team.

* Direct line of sight from your work to client revenue and impact.

* Access to systems, training, and playbooks on cutting-edge content and monetization.



If you want a role where you’re judged by output and growth, not meetings and politics, this is it.

s independently.

title: Ad Editor & Producer - AI Video (Veo 3, Nano Banana)
description:
I run a small US-based marketing and video production company. We make and run
 and Instagram ads for local service businesses and professional service firms across the US. I'm looking for an editor and producer to own the creative output.



Let me be clear about what this role is, because I think it gets confused a lot. I am not looking for a media buyer. I'm looking for the person who MAKES the ads. The one who d
 what the first two seconds look like, cuts the thing, and hands me something I'm excited to put spend behind. Plenty of people can click around Ads Manager. Very few can produce creative that's actually worth running.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Cutting short-form direct response ads, mostly 15 to 45 seconds, for a rotating set of clients

- Generating AI video and imagery with Veo 3 and Nano Banana Pro, mostly through the KIE API, and blending it with real footage we shoot or the client provides

- Building variations. Same offer, different hooks, different openers, so we can actually test

- Captions, subtitles, sound design, the whole finish

- Working from creative briefs and scripts I give you, and pushing back when you think there's a better angle



WHAT I NEED TO SEE

- Ads you personally made that actually ran with money behind them. Not spec work, not a showreel of wedding films. If you can tell me what the hook rate or CPA looked like, even better, but at minimum I want to see ads that went live.

- You understand why the first three seconds d
 everything, and you can articulate what makes a hook work

- Real editing chops. Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, I don't care which. I care that the output is clean.

- Fast, self-directed, and you meet deadlines without me chasing you



STRONG PLUS

- Hands-on experience with Veo 3, Nano Banana Pro, Runway, Kling or similar. If you haven't used these yet but you're a strong editor and you learn fast, still apply. The tools take about two weeks to get good at. Taste doesn't.

- Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, and comfort reading performance data to inform the next round of creative. This is genuinely a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

- Experience with professional service or regulated verticals



PAY

Starting around $7 to $10 per hour depending on experience. I'm open to structuring this either hourly or as a flat rate per completed ad or per ad batch, whichever ends up making more sense once we see your speed and output. Happy to talk it through.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word RIPTIDE.



2. Send 2 to 3 examples of ads you made that ran. Tell me briefly what your role was on each, what the offer was, and anything you know about how it performed.



3. Tell me what AI video or image tools you've actually used and what you made with them.



4. Pick any ad you've seen recently, yours or someone else's, and tell me in a few sentences why the hook works or doesn't.



Finalists get a paid test project. I'll give you a brief and $25 to produce one short AI-assisted ad. I don't ask for free work.



If this sounds like your kind of thing, send it over. Happy to answer questions either way.

title: Part-Time Outreach VA - Cold Calls, Email & DMs (US Company)
description:
Hey, I run a small US-based marketing and video production company. We run paid ads and lead generation for local service businesses and professional service firms across the US. Things have grown to the point where my ops manager can't absorb everything anymore, so I'm looking for one more person to take the overflow.



This is not a rigid corporate role. It's about 10-15 hours a week, and the work splits two ways.



WHEN I ASSIGN YOU TASKS, you do those. Research, list building, data cleanup, follow-ups, CRM tidying, whatever is on the board that week. It varies.



WHEN I DON'T, your default is outreach. Cold calls, cold
s, and Instagram or LinkedIn DMs. This is the floor, not the fallback. Roughly 40 dials or 60
s a day depending on which lane you're in that day.



HOURS

Most of your week is flexible, work when it suits you. The one requirement is a 2 to 3 hour overlap with US Pacific mornings for the calling block. We'll settle the exact window together.



PAY

$4.50 to $6.50 per hour depending on experience, plus $10 for every qualified appointment you book. The bonus has no cap. If you're good on the phone, that's where the real money is.



WHAT I ACTUALLY NEED FROM YOU

- Spoken English that sounds natural to an American ear. This is the number one thing. You'll be talking to office managers, front desk staff, and intake coordinators, and if they can't follow you easily, the call is over.

- Comfort on the phone. People are going to brush you off. That has to roll off you.

- Reliable internet and a decent headset. No background noise.

- You write clean
s and DMs without me rewriting them.

- You tell me when something isn't working instead of quietly grinding on it for two weeks.



NICE TO HAVE, NOT REQUIRED

- GoHighLevel experience

- Instantly, Apollo, Smartlead or similar cold
 tools

- Any experience selling to US businesses



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word MARLIN so I know you read this far.



2. Record a short voice clip (Vocaroo, Google Drive, whatever is easiest) reading exactly this, like you're actually on the call:

"Hi, this is [your name], I'm trying to reach whoever handles marketing for the office. We run lead generation campaigns for businesses like yours and I wanted to see if that's worth thirty seconds of your time."



3. Answer this in two or three sentences: you call an office and the person who picks up says "we're not interested" before you finish your first sentence. What do you say next?



Please don't send a generic self-intro recording, I'll skip those. The script above is the one I'm listening to.



Applications without the code word and the voice clip won't get read. Not trying to be difficult, I just get a lot of copy-paste and this is the fastest way to find the real ones.

title: US Client Success Specialist – $2,000/month Base + Uncapped Commissions (USD)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility

BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

title: Receptionist and Intake Coordinator
description:
Remote Receptionist & Intake Coordinator

U.S. Immigration Law Firm | Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines

The Law Offices of Fogam & Associates, LLC, a U.S.-based immigration law firm, is seeking an exceptional Remote Receptionist & Intake Coordinator based in the Philippines.

This is a front-line client-service position. You will often be the first person prospective and existing clients speak with. We therefore require excellent spoken and written English, strong listening skills, sound judgment, professionalism, warmth, accuracy, and exceptional reliability.

This is not simply a call-answering position. The successful candidate must follow detailed scripts and procedures, listen carefully, obtain and record important information, distinguish between types of calls, identify potentially urgent matters, assist with preliminary intake and qualification, and communicate information promptly and accurately to our U.S. office.

Primary Responsibilities

• Answer incoming calls promptly, warmly, and professionally.

• Follow firm-approved telephone, intake, client-service, qualification, and follow-up scripts.

• Listen carefully and ask appropriate scripted follow-up questions.

• Accurately document the caller's identity, contact information, reason for calling, important dates/deadlines, requested action, and appropriate next step.

• Conduct preliminary intake and qualification of prospective clients using firm procedures. Do not provide legal advice.

• Identify promising or time-sensitive prospective-client inquiries and promptly transmit them to the Office Administrator or Operations Manager.

• Coordinate or schedule appointments with the Office Administrator or Operations Manager when authorized by firm procedures.

• Do not schedule appointments directly with Attorney Fogam and do not represent that you have access to his calendar.

• Follow up with prospective clients according to established procedures and scripts.

• Route existing-client calls and messages to the appropriate team member.

• Recognize potentially urgent situations and immediately escalate them according to the firm's escalation protocol.

• Prepare clear, concise written summaries of calls and communications.

• Send routine call/activity digests approximately every two hours to the Office Administrator.

• Send urgent matters immediately; do not wait for the next two-hour report.

• Send qualified or high-priority prospective-client opportunities promptly after the call.

• Prepare a detailed end-of-day report accounting for calls, inquiries, follow-ups, unresolved matters, and required next actions.

• Maintain strict confidentiality concerning all client and firm information.

Communication & Escalation

Receptionist → Office Administrator → Operations Manager → Attorney

Routine matters should be handled or routed without unnecessarily involving the attorney. Potential emergencies must be escalated immediately. The receptionist should not bypass the chain of responsibility except where a firm procedure specifically requires it.

Required Qualifications

• Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong listening comprehension.

• Excellent written English.

• Ability to understand different accents and callers who may speak imperfect English.

• Strong telephone presence and professional demeanor.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to summarize conversations accurately.

• Ability to follow scripts without sounding robotic.

• Good judgment concerning urgency, priority, and escalation.

• Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software.

• Reliable high-speed internet, computer, professional headset, and quiet workspace.

• Ability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

• Strong attendance, punctuality, coachability, and confidentiality.

Experience as a legal receptionist, intake specialist, virtual assistant, customer-service representative, call-center representative, or with a U.S.-based professional-services organization is preferred but not required. Immigration law experience is helpful but not required.

Application Instructions

1. Submit your résumé.

2. Provide a brief written explanation of why you are suited for this position.

3. Submit a 60-90 second audio or video introduction in English explaining your experience and why you would be effective speaking with clients of a U.S. law firm.

4. Provide your internet speed and computer/headset specifications.

5. Confirm that you can work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

Selected applicants will complete a short written/computer assessment and telephone role-playing exercises.

Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable spending substantial portions of the workday speaking with clients and prospective clients by telephone.

title: Freight Dispatcher — U.S. Trucking (Experience Required, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
About us

WH Trucking is a U.S.-based asset carrier operating out of Georgia. We run dedicated contract freight, intermodal/rail moves, and spot loads. We are a small team that moves fast, and you will work directly with the owner.



We are hiring four dispatchers to build out 24/7 coverage. This is a long-term position with room to grow as we add trucks.



A note on the schedule: our night shift runs 6:00 PM – 6:00 AM U.S. Eastern, which is approximately 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine time. If you are assigned nights, you will be working normal daytime hours locally.



What you'll do

Coordinate daily load assignments and driver schedules

Communicate with drivers throughout your shift on pickups, deliveries, and delays

Manage a dedicated contract account with recurring weekly loads

Handle rail/intermodal pickups and in-gate coordination

Track loads from pickup through delivery; flag problems before they escalate

Collect and file BOLs, PODs, and rate confirmations

Maintain dispatch trackers and operational spreadsheets

Escalate facility, appointment, and detention issues

Support spot load bidding and rate research

Hand off cleanly to the incoming dispatcher at shift change



Required

Prior U.S. freight dispatching experience. This is not negotiable. In your application, name the carriers or brokerages you dispatched for and the fleet size.

Strong written and spoken English — you will speak with U.S. drivers and facility staff every shift

Confident on the phone, including with frustrated drivers

Proficient in Google Workspace (Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Docs)

Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, and a plan for power outages

Quiet, dedicated workspace

Self-starter who solves problems rather than forwarding them



Nice to have — we will train

Amazon Relay experience

Intermodal / rail experience (CSX, BNSF)

Any TMS experience

FMCSA compliance familiarity

Small-fleet dispatch experience (as opposed to large carrier)



Availability requirements

This is a 12-hour shift position on a rotating schedule averaging 42 hours per week, with every other weekend off.



Dispatch is a live-coverage role. Trucks, drivers, and facilities do not wait, and no one else can cover your desk while you are away from it. This position requires:



Full availability for your entire 12-hour shift, without interruption

A dedicated workspace separate from household activity

Reliable internet plus a backup connection and a power outage plan

No other concurrent job or client work during your shift

Consistent attendance — coverage gaps directly affect our customer accounts

Willingness to work either day or night rotation as assigned



Please be honest with yourself about this before applying. If your current situation does not allow you to be at your desk and responsive for a full 12-hour block, this role will not be a good fit, and we would rather you apply for something that suits your schedule better.



HOW TO APPLY 

To apply, complete BOTH steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Send your resume and answer in your own words: Which carriers or brokerages have you dispatched for, and how many trucks?



Step 2 — Record a Loom video (3 minutes maximum).



Record yourself as if you are on the phone with one of our drivers. He has arrived at a rail facility to pick up a load. The kiosk says there is no waybill for his load, so he cannot get in the gate. He has been waiting 40 minutes and he is frustrated.



Talk through how you would handle that call and what you would do next.



Do not script it. We want to hear how you actually think.



Include your Loom link with your application.

title: Crypto BD Team Lead | DeFi Partnerships & Qualified Appointment Setting  Crypto BD Lead
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.
