title: Real Estate Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant
description:
Real Estate Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant



Part-Time to Start: 20 Hours/Week

$4–$5 USD/Hour Depending on Experience

Opportunity to Grow to 40 Hours/Week + Raises & Bonuses

Long-Term Position | Philippines-Based

U.S. Real Estate Business – Honolulu, Hawaii



About the Position



I am an experienced real estate broker in Honolulu, Hawaii looking for a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Virtual Assistant to become a long-term member of my real estate business.



This position will start at approximately 20 hours per week while we learn how to work together, develop systems, and determine where you can provide the most value.



I am not looking for a temporary freelancer.



My goal is to find the right person who wants to grow with my business for years. As you demonstrate your abilities and the business grows, my goal is to increase this position toward 40 hours per week, increase your hourly compensation, and develop additional performance and/or transaction-based bonuses.



There may also be opportunities for additional training, equipment, software, bonuses, and other benefits as our relationship and the business grow.



I want to invest in the right person.



Who I’m Looking For



You do NOT need to be an expert in everything listed below.



I care more about finding the right person with the right attitude, personality, work ethic, and ability to learn.



I’m looking for someone who is:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Reliable and consistent

* Proactive and able to work independently

* Comfortable making reasonable decisions based on established processes

* Good at prioritizing based on deadlines and importance

* Comfortable with repetitive and tedious tasks

* Someone who actually enjoys checklists, organization, spreadsheets, CRM cleanup, and completing unfinished tasks

* A problem solver who tries to find solutions

* Comfortable learning new technology

* A strong written and verbal English communicator

* Persistent about following things through to completion

* Able to identify when something is being forgotten

* Comfortable reminding and holding me accountable when necessary

* Interested in learning and taking on greater responsibility over time



I move quickly and frequently have multiple clients, leads, listings, transactions, and projects happening simultaneously.



I need someone who can eventually become my right-hand person and help make sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



If I tell you that I need to call someone and haven’t done it, remind me.



If a transaction deadline is approaching, recognize it and make sure we address it.



If a lead hasn’t been followed up with, bring it to my attention.



If something is unfinished, keep track of it until it’s completed.



Eventually, I want you to be able to tell me:



“Here are the things that need your personal attention today. I’ve already handled everything else.”



Primary Responsibilities



CRM & Lead Management



* Manage and organize Follow Up Boss CRM

* Enter and update contacts

* Clean up duplicate and incomplete records

* Tag and categorize leads and clients

* Maintain accurate notes, stages, tasks, and follow-up dates

* Identify leads that need follow-up

* Create daily follow-up lists for me

* Track outstanding conversations and next steps

* Help make sure leads don’t get forgotten

* Assist with database nurture and reactivation campaigns

* Help organize prospecting and call lists



, Calendar & Organization



* Help manage and organize my

* Identify important
s requiring my attention

* Draft routine
s and responses

* Maintain follow-up reminders

* Manage appointments and scheduling

* Help manage my calendar

* Maintain daily and weekly priority/task lists

* Follow up on unfinished tasks

* Keep track of people we are waiting to hear from

* Help keep me focused on high-priority activities



Transaction Coordination



* Maintain transaction timelines and checklists

* Track contract dates and deadlines

* Organize transaction documents

* Help process sales paperwork

* Assist with preparing offers, addenda, and other real estate documents for my review

* Coordinate with clients, escrow/title, lenders, inspectors, agents, photographers, and vendors

* Follow up on outstanding documents and tasks

* Maintain organized electronic transaction files

* Assist with closing and post-closing processes

* Make sure transaction requirements and deadlines don’t get missed



All activities must remain within applicable real estate licensing requirements. Anything requiring a licensed real estate professional will be handled or approved by me.



Listing Coordination



* Input and update real estate listings

* Organize listing paperwork and disclosures

* Coordinate photography, video, staging, inspections, and other vendors

* Organize listing photos and marketing materials

* Help prepare property descriptions

* Update listing information as needed

* Track showing activity and feedback

* Assist with seller updates

* Coordinate open houses and marketing schedules

* Maintain listing checklists from pre-listing through closing



Client & Lead Communication



As you learn my business and communication style:



* Send routine follow-ups on my behalf

* Follow up with leads and clients

* Schedule appointments and showings

* Communicate with vendors and business partners

* Request reviews and testimonials

* Help maintain contact with past clients

* Make sure clients receive timely responses

* Draft
s and text messages for my approval when needed



Excellent written and spoken English is important.



Social Media & Marketing



Help create, edit, schedule, and manage content for:



*

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

* TikTok

* Google Business Profile

* YouTube/short-form video as we grow



Content may include:



* New listings

* Open houses

* Sold/closed properties

* Client testimonials

* Real estate information

* Market updates

* Educational content

* Community/local Hawaii content

* Videos/Reels

* Personal branding



Responsibilities may include:



* Canva graphics

* Basic photo editing

* Video/Reels editing

* Writing captions

* Scheduling posts

* Repurposing content across platforms

* Organizing content calendars

* Tracking basic engagement and results



AI & Technology



I use technology extensively and want someone who is comfortable learning and using AI.



Tools may include:



* Follow Up Boss

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Google Drive

* Google Docs

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Word

* Microsoft Excel

* Canva

* Photo and video editing software

*

* Instagram

* LinkedIn

* TikTok

* MLS systems

* Real estate transaction software



Experience with some of these is preferred.



You do not need to know everything.



What matters more is that you’re comfortable learning new systems and can figure things out.



Future Areas You Can Grow Into



As you become comfortable with the core responsibilities, there will be opportunities to learn and take ownership of:



* Creating and maintaining SOPs

* Google Business Profile optimization

* Local SEO

* Website/blog content

* AI search optimization

*
 marketing

* Lead generation

* Prospecting and call-list creation

* Database marketing

*
/Meta Ads

* Marketing analytics

* Business reporting

* Client retention programs

* Past-client/referral campaigns

* Additional business systems and automation



I am happy to provide training and invest in developing the right person.



Growth & Compensation



Starting compensation: $4–$5 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level.



We will initially start at approximately 20 hours per week.



This is intentionally a part-time starting position while we learn how to work together and build the role.



My goal for the right person is to eventually grow this into a 40-hour-per-week, long-term position.



As you demonstrate reliability, learn the business, take ownership, and create more value, there will be opportunities for:



* Increased hours

* Increased hourly compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Transaction/closing bonuses

* Additional paid training

* Equipment or technology support

* Increased responsibilities

* Career advancement as the business grows



The exact bonus and compensation structure will evolve based on your role and contribution to the business.



I want our incentives aligned.



If you help me become more organized, serve more clients, close more transactions, and grow the business, I want you to have the opportunity to grow professionally and financially with me.



Schedule



We will start at approximately 20 hours per week.



Because my business is located in Honolulu, Hawaii, some overlap with Hawaii business hours will be important for communication, client follow-up, and time-sensitive real estate matters.



Other responsibilities can be completed independently.



Please tell me:



* Your preferred working hours

* Your availability

* Whether you currently work for other clients

* Whether you would eventually be interested in working 40 hours/week if the position grows



Requirements



* Excellent written English

* Strong spoken English

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quiet and professional workspace

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organization and time management

* Ability to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working independently

* Willingness to learn

* Professional and dependable



Previous U.S. real estate experience is highly preferred but not necessarily required for an exceptional candidate who learns quickly and has the right skills and personality.



How to Apply



Please start your application with:



ALOHA CHAD



Applications that don’t include this will not be considered. I want to know that you read the entire job description.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Why this particular position interests you.

3. Your experience supporting U.S. real estate professionals, if any.

4. Your experience with transaction coordination and real estate paperwork.

5. Your experience with Follow Up Boss or other CRMs.

6. The software and AI tools you know.

7. Your experience with social media, Canva, photo/video editing, SEO, or digital marketing.

8. Your desired starting hourly rate.

9. Your available hours per week.

10. Your preferred working schedule.

11. Whether you would eventually want to move into a 40-hour/week position.

12. Your DISC assessment results, if you have them.



Please also include a 1–2 minute video introduction.



Tell me:



* Who you are

* Your relevant experience

* What you’re particularly good at

* Why you think you would be a good long-term fit for this position



Finally, answer this scenario:



You start your workday and discover that I have 8 leads needing follow-up, a transaction deadline tomorrow, 15 unread client
s, a social media post scheduled for today that isn’t finished, and 500 CRM contacts that need cleanup. How would you prioritize these tasks and why?



There isn’t necessarily one perfect answer. I’m interested in understanding how you think, prioritize, communicate, and solve problems.



Long-Term Opportunity



I am looking for more than someone who completes tasks.



I’m looking for someone who wants to learn my business, understand how I work, help build better systems, and gradually take ownership of important parts of the operation.



We may start at 20 hours per week, but my goal is to find someone who can eventually become a full-time, trusted member of my business for years to come.



If you’re organized, proactive, dependable, enjoy getting things completed, and want an opportunity where your responsibilities and compensation can grow with the business, I would like to hear from you.

title: Guest Experience & Operations Coordinator – Short-Term Rentals
description:
About Cabin Living



Cabin Living is a growing Norwegian short-term rental management company managing holiday homes, cabins and apartments across Norway.



We provide full-service property management for our owners and take care of the entire guest journey – from booking and pre-arrival communication to check-in, problem-solving during the stay and follow-up after departure.



We are now looking for an experienced Guest Experience & Operations Coordinator to become an important part of our operations team.



This is not a basic Virtual Assistant position.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of situations, solve problems independently and make both guests and property owners feel that they are in professional hands.



Your Main Responsibility



Your job is simple to describe:



Make sure things get solved.



When a guest has a problem, we don't only want someone who replies to the message.



We want someone who understands the problem, takes ownership, finds a solution, coordinates the right people and follows the case until it is closed.



You will communicate with guests, property owners, cleaners, maintenance partners and our internal team.



Typical Responsibilities

Guest Experience

Respond to guest messages through our property management system and booking platforms

Handle questions before, during and after stays

Assist guests with check-in and check-out

Troubleshoot access problems, WiFi, heating, hot water and other property-related issues

Handle complaints professionally and calmly

Proactively follow up guests when an issue occurs

Protect the guest experience and our review scores

Operations

Coordinate cleaners, linen providers, caretakers and maintenance partners

Handle situations where cleaning has not been completed correctly

Arrange assistance when something needs to be fixed

Follow operational cases until they are actually resolved

Document incidents and actions taken

Escalate serious situations according to our SOP

Property Owner Communication



You will also communicate with our property owners.



This requires a different communication style than guest support.



Our owners trust us with valuable homes and expect professional, accurate and confident communication.



You must therefore be comfortable explaining situations clearly and professionally to property owners.



What We Are Looking For

Required

Excellent spoken and written English

Strong communication skills

Excellent problem-solving ability

High level of personal responsibility

Calm under pressure

Very organised

Comfortable making decisions

Comfortable calling guests and suppliers when necessary

Stable high-speed internet

Quiet professional workspace

Reliable computer and backup solution

Ability to work European/Norwegian hours

Strongly Preferred



Previous experience with one or more of:



Short-term rentals

Airbnb

Booking.com

VRBO

Property management

Hotels or hospitality

Guest experience

Customer support

Property maintenance coordination

PMS/property management software



Experience with short-term rentals will be considered a major advantage.



The Person We DON'T Want



We are not looking for someone whose standard response to a problem is:



"I informed my manager."



We are looking for someone who thinks:



"How can I solve this?"



You should know when to follow a procedure, when to investigate further and when a situation genuinely needs to be escalated.



Example



A guest arrives at 10:30 PM and cannot access the property.



The owner doesn't answer.



What do you do?



We expect you to:



Respond immediately.

Verify the information and access instructions.

Troubleshoot the problem.

Contact relevant local resources if necessary.

Keep the guest informed.

Find an alternative solution if the first solution fails.

Document what happened.

Escalate only when necessary.



That mindset is extremely important to us.



About the Position



This is intended to be a long-term position.



Cabin Living is growing and we want someone who can grow with the company and gradually take greater responsibility.



You will receive:



Detailed SOPs and operational procedures

Training in our systems

Clear escalation procedures

Templates and communication guidelines

Support from our management team



But we expect you to eventually operate independently within those procedures.



Working Hours



The position requires significant overlap with Norwegian/European time (CET/CEST).



Short-term rentals operate seven days a week, so some weekend work will be required.



Exact working hours and rotation will be agreed with the successful candidate.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your CV



2. A short description of your experience with short-term rentals, hospitality or customer service.



Please be specific about:



Number of properties you supported

Booking platforms you worked with

PMS/software you have used

Your responsibilities

Whether you communicated directly with property owners



3. A 90-second video introduction in English.



Please introduce yourself and tell us:



Who you are

Your relevant experience

Why you think you would be good at this role



Please do not read from a prepared AI-generated script. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



4. Answer this question in your application:



A guest checks into a cabin at 9:30 PM.



They message you:



"There is no hot water. We have three children and this is unacceptable. We want a refund."



The owner does not answer the phone.



Explain exactly what you would do during the next 30 minutes.



We are more interested in how you think than in getting a perfect answer.



Applications that do not include the video and case response will not be considered.



Important



Please start your application with the words:



"I solve problems."

title: Full-Time Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve) - Testimonial & Talking-Head Content
description:
Before anything else: if you're replying to this with something AI wrote for you, don't bother, I can tell and I'll just skip the application. If you're a real editor who actually wants this, start your message with a link to one testimonial or talking-head style video you think can convert as a paid-ad, and one sentence on why. That's the only test before we talk properly, and it also tells me if you actually know what makes this kind of video good. If you have no experience, but is willing to learn, we'll be offering training so you can LEVEL UP. We believe in hiring people who are quick to learn through constructive feedback, andbuild skills that they can use FOREVER.



I run DTM Media, a small video agency in Melbourne. We make short-form content for a couple of retainer clients, mostly testimonial and talking-head videos, the kind that live or die on the first three seconds and can't afford a boring middle. Right now we're overloaded with edits, and want frequent variations to creatives to reduce fatigue! We also do more creative edits, and if you are capable and have a style of editing we like - we'll be down to get you onboard aswell :)



This is a full-time role - I want someone constantly on the ball! However, I am very flexible - if you can get the work done I am happy to pay by edit/project and organise other flexible hourly/per project basis. I will still pay during the training phase!



What the job actually is: cutting testimonial and talking-head videos to batches of potential videos that can be created for paid ads - ensuring there is clear pacing, captions, hook, and CTA. There's also some general admin and other small production tasks that come up, this isn't a role where you only ever touch one thing.



You'll get a proper written/visual guide and training directly from the team before you start covering exactly what "good" looks like for our videos, so you're not guessing. There's also a short paid test project first, real but small, so you can show me what you've got and I can see if this is a fit before either of us commits further. We'll have two styles - one focused around talking head, and another that is more creative (like real estate). 



Straight talk on commitment: I'm hiring for the next couple of months to start. If it's working, and I think it will if you're genuinely good at this, there's a real path to staying long-term. I'd rather build with one person over time than keep restarting every few months. And even if it doesn't become permanent, real agency client work is a solid thing to have on your record for whatever's next.



What I need: solid DaVinci Resolve skills (color, basic audio, captions, exports). Real experience editing short-form vertical content, TikTok, Reels, testimonials, not just long-form. You can follow a brief exactly instead of doing your own thing with it. You're actually online and reliable during work hours, not just "available when convenient." Good enough written English that a brief lands the first time.



Reply with the video link and your one sentence like I said above, then tell me about your editing background and the hours you're actually free.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the creative process from concept through to execution, producing visually compelling content that reflects the brand’s identity, engages the target audience, and supports marketing and commercial objectives.

This is a senior creative role requiring strong visual judgement, excellent attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously.



Key Responsibilities:



● Develop creative concepts and visual content for the Life Interiors website, social media platforms, and YouTube channel.

About you:

We believe in the power of accurate numbers and, more importantly, in using those numbers to understand the business, solve problems and drive growth in real time. Our team don't just balance books or help companies stay compliant for the ATO. We are all advisors for our clients and offer solutions, insights and support to our clients that goes beyond reconciliation.



We are growing quickly and will need a qualified accountant to join our team. The hours will be in line with Australian Eastern Standard Time. This is a full time permanent position.



You will work 100% remote and need to have fast internet connection and your own device already.



We are seeking someone who has Australian experience already. The day to day responsibilities will include



Working knowledge of client accounting systems (Xero, MYOB, etc.)

Prepare tax returns (individuals, partnerships, trusts, companies, FBT)



Prepare management accounts (monthly/quarterly) with analysis



Prepare special purpose financial accounts & assist with general purpose accounts



Early-stage direct client involvement



Identify client service improvements/add-value opportunities

Update client org charts & processes

ABOUT US



The 30 Hour Coach is an online mentorship for online fitness coaches. We take coaches doing $5k to $30k a month, working far too many hours, and get them to $50k months and beyond.

 what gets made. You make it well.

- Thumbnails and cover frames

- Keep our drives, footage and b-roll library organised so anyone can find anything (currently using 
)



You are not expected to come up with the content. You are expected to execute it well, fast, and to the brief, every week, without being chased.



YOU MUST HAVE



- At least 1 year editing short-form vertical video for a brand, agency or creator

- DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro

- Photoshop, Figma and Canva for design work

- A portfolio of vertical video you personally cut, plus at least one carousel or static design

NICE TO HAVE

- Fitness, health or coaching content experience

- Experience clipping long recordings (podcasts, webinars, calls) into shorts

- Experience editing lesson or course video



WHAT WE OFFER



- $1000 USD per month, paid via Wise. Twice monthly is preferred, but we are flexible if you need a different split

- 13th month pay

- A long-term role. We want someone for years, not for a project

- One brand, one design system, one person to report to. No juggling five clients with five different styles



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. Applications that skip these steps get deleted without a reply.



1. Start your message with the word ORANGE.



2. Send 3 links to vertical short-form videos you personally edited, plus 1 carousel or static design you made. For each video, tell me in a single sentence what you were trying to make the viewer feel in the first 2 seconds.



3. Tell me what software you use.



4. Tell me how many hours a week you are currently committed to other clients.



5. Answer this question: a client sends you a 90 second talking-head recording and asks for a 45 second short. What do you cut first, and why?



Do not send a generic cover letter. I read every application that follows these five steps, and I ignore every one that does not.



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Social Media Content Creator (Reels + Graphics) for Health & Wellness Brands
description:
Hi, my name is James. I'm a Doctor of Osteopathy based in Melbourne, Australia, and I run two businesses I'd love your help with. I'm looking for someone to create social media content for both. I would really appreciate some help with creating consistent, high-quality educational and product content (reels, static posts, carousels, short-form video) across Instagram,
, and TikTok for two related brands in the health and pain-relief space.



Business 1: Bond Osteopathy

Bond Osteopathy is my osteopathy clinic. I treat people for musculoskeletal issues - back pain, neck pain, joint and muscle complaints, posture, mobility, and injury recovery.

What I want to post:

* Educational content about the human body, common musculoskeletal problems, and how osteopathy helps

* Reels demonstrating stretches, mobility drills, posture tips, and "why does X hurt" explainers. I will record the videos and then you can edit them for me.

* Static posts and carousels breaking down anatomy, conditions, and self-care advice in plain language

* Content that builds trust and positions me as a knowledgeable, approachable practitioner and drives local patient bookings

Tone: professional but warm and accessible — no jargon that scares people off. 

Business 2: Knotty Body





Knotty Body is a practitioner-formulated massage cream brand I founded. It's sold direct to consumers online (Shopify) and to allied health clinics. Because I'm an osteopath, the brand's whole positioning is "formulated by a hands-on practitioner who actually treats pain" — real credibility, not generic wellness fluff.

What I want to post:

* Product education — what the cream is, how and when to use it, who it's for

* Reels and short video showing the product in use (application demos, massage routines, pairing with stretches)

* Static posts and carousels

* Lifestyle and brand-building content that makes the product feel premium and trustworthy

* Content that drives online sales and supports clinic/wholesale interest

Tone: clean, premium, credible — health-led, not gimmicky.



What I'm looking for in you

* Proven social media content creation (reels + static)

* Strong short-form video editing

* Reliable, consistent output and good communication

* Bonus: experience with health, wellness, fitness, or e-commerce brands

* Bonus: Canva and basic graphic design 

Ways of working

* I'll provide raw footage, product info, and direction; you turn it into finished, on-brand content

* Open to a content calendar/batching workflow

* Two distinct brands, so you'll need to switch between an educational clinical voice (Bond) and a premium product voice (Knotty Body)



To apply: Please start your reply with the word "KNOTTY" so I know you've read this properly, and include 2–3 links to reels you personally edited. Let me know your availability and your rate. Looking forward to seeing your work!



Thanks for your time



- James

title: Tax Filer
description:
We are seeking Tax Filers to join a growing sales and use tax compliance team. The ideal candidate is someone who works comfortably against a high-volume filing calendar, knows when to stop and escalate rather than guess, and takes pride in clean documentation. Prepare, enter, upload, and transmit sales and use tax returns through EDI, online portals, key entry, checks, mail, and other required channels.

Complete online balance reviews and process approved voucher and filing adjustments.

Retain filing confirmations, submission evidence, and supporting documentation for every return transmitted.

Escalate discrepancies or missing information ahead of deadlines without independently altering approved source data, tax positions, or client scope.

Return incomplete filing packages upstream with a specific exception noted and a clear deadline for resolution.

Process or coordinate jurisdiction payments in line with approved controls and funding instructions.

Reconcile filed liabilities, payment confirmations, online balances, and the check register.

Research uncleared, rejected, duplicate, or misapplied payments and coordinate corrective action through to resolution.

Log, receive, and research jurisdictional notices across both mail and online channels.

Review account history and jurisdiction records, prepare notice responses, and submit approved correspondence.

Track notice matters through to full resolution and maintain accurate status records.

Escalate notices involving client decisions, material exposure, taxability positions, or broader account risk to the appropriate stakeholders.

Follow documented filing, payment, credential, evidence retention, and escalation controls without deviation.

Provide timely status updates and exception reporting to the engagement lead and manager.

Identify recurring filing, payment, portal, and notice issues and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Manage a high-volume deadline calendar aligned to jurisdictional due dates throughout each monthly cycle.



Qualifications:



At least 5 years of experience in indirect tax, compliance, accounting operations, or a similar deadline-driven function.

Prior experience supporting US-based clients or US tax operations.

Working knowledge of multistate sales and use tax filing processes and jurisdictional requirements.

Hands-on experience with tax compliance software, jurisdiction portals, EDI transmission, and multiple payment methods.

Intermediate or stronger Excel skills, with strong reconciliation and data entry accuracy.

Proven ability to manage a high-volume deadline calendar with exceptional accuracy and follow-through.

Strong documentation discipline and the ability to preserve a complete audit trail.

Sound escalation judgment — knows when to stop, flag, and seek approval rather than proceed on assumption.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with internal teams and taxing jurisdictions.

Strong organizational and time management skills across competing monthly deadlines.

· VAs and freelancers who need a US number so international

· OFWs who need to keep an active number for OTP and bank messages

· Travelers who want internet the moment they land

program: people who share the service with their network and

earn from the customers and partners they bring in.



Bees Mobile is now opening the Philippine market and hiring a

small founding team to build the partner network from zero.



─────────────────────────────



THE ROLE



You will build the Bees Mobile partner network in the

Philippines. Not one customer at a time — you find people who can

build teams, bring them in, train them, and help them grow.



If you have built a direct-selling or network-marketing

organization before, you already know this job. If you have led

a large team of agents, resellers, or freelancers and know how to

keep them active, you know most of it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

· Recruit partners across the Philippines — both experienced

  team leaders (direct-selling leaders, insurance unit managers,

  reseller and agent network heads) and motivated newcomers who

  want to start

· Run online presentations (Zoom / Messenger / FB Live) to

  explain the service and partner program — materials provided

  and scripts

· Keep partners active: regular check-ins, answer questions,

  solve problems

· Monitor what partners post and make sure it follows the

  communication standards

· Work with the marketing team on local campaigns: you tell them

  what works in the Philippines and what doesn't

· Track your numbers and send a weekly report to head office



─────────────────────────────



HOW THE TRIAL WORKS



A small founding team starts on a 3-month paid trial with clear,

written targets. Strong performers convert to permanent roles

with a higher base salary. You will get honest feedback on how

you are doing, and the same is expected from you.



─────────────────────────────



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED

· 5+ years recruiting, building, or leading teams, including a

  team of 10 or more that you personally recruited and trained

· Experience in direct selling, network marketing, insurance

  agency, reseller networks, or similar — you understand how

  organizations are built, not just managed

· Excellent written and spoken English; fluent Tagalog

· Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in

  your daily work

· Strong, stable internet and a quiet place to make calls and

  run online presentations

· Organized: you keep records, you follow up, nothing slips

· Self-managed: nobody will be watching over your shoulder,

  and results are still expected

· Honest and direct — you report bad news early



NICE TO HAVE

· You have personally built a downline or organization of

  100+ people

· Experience with
 / Messenger-based recruiting

· An existing network in VA, OFW, or travel communities

· Bisaya or other regional languages



─────────────────────────────



WHAT WE OFFER

· Full-time, long-term position after the trial — not a project

· USD 600 – 1,000/month trial base, up to USD 1,300 base after

  conversion, plus performance bonus with written targets

· Training materials, presentation decks, and scripts provided —

  you spend your time on people, not paperwork



─────────────────────────────



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without the video will not be reviewed.



Send us:

1. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile link

2. A 3-MINUTE VIDEO INTRODUCTION IN ENGLISH, answering:

   a. The largest team or organization you personally built —

      how many people, how long it took, and how you did it

      and how you handled it

      90 days, where would you find them and what would you

      say to them

   d. Why this role interests you

   A phone recording is fine. What you say matters, not

   production quality.

3. Start your message with the word "BEES" so we know you read

Every applicant who follows these instructions will get a reply.



Bees Mobile Hiring Team

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

title: Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist — AI-Driven DTC Health Ads ($1,000/mo+)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

 

We are a fast-growing DTC health supplement brand (Revalia — Ethiopian black seed oil, primarily targeting arthritis with many other angles in testing) running direct response video ads on Meta to adults 50+ in the United States. We are hiring a full-time Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist who can own an ad end to end — concept, script, and edit — not just cut footage together.

 

WHAT THIS ROLE IS:

 

You are not editing vlogs, YouTube videos, or social media content. You are creating direct response video ads that run on cold traffic at real ad spend. Every frame, every transition, every piece of b-roll, every voiceover cut exists for one reason: to keep a skeptical 60-year-old watching long enough to click. If the ad doesn't perform, it gets killed. The creative is the difference between an ad that scales and an ad that dies in testing.

 

This role is not for someone who needs to be handed a script and told what to do. You come up with the concept, write the script, and build the ad yourself. If you have only edited brand content, social media reels, or YouTube videos — or you can only execute other people's ideas — this role is not for you.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 

You will own the full creative pipeline: concept → script → edit → deliver. One person, full production. On every ad you are making the creative decisions:

 

- Coming up with the concept and angle. You study the brand, the audience, and the mechanism, and you generate ad ideas that will actually convert to cold traffic.

- Writing the script yourself. Most ads run 30-60 seconds, but longer formats (up to 3-5 minutes) get made too when the angle calls for it — you use your judgment based on what's working. Hook, body, CTA. You know how a fear-based ad, a discovery ad, a doctor ad, and a personal-story ad each need to be written differently.

- Choosing and generating the right b-roll for every section. Not just "find a clip that matches the words." You d
 what visual makes the viewer FEEL something at that exact moment.

- Pacing the hook so the first 3 seconds stop the scroll. The hook isn't just the first line — it's the first visual, the first sound, the first text on screen, and the speed at which all three hit at once.

- Casting the voiceover tone to match the script's intent, selecting music that supports the emotion without competing with the voiceover, designing captions that feel native to the platform, and building transitions the viewer moves through without noticing.

 

You are not editing. You are building ads from a blank page.

 

AI IS NOT OPTIONAL:

 

We use AI tools heavily and daily. This is not a traditional role where you sit in Premiere for 8 hours cutting footage someone else shot. You are generating AI UGC, AI voiceovers, AI b-roll, AI animations, and combining them with real footage to create ads that look and feel authentic.

 

Tools we use include:

- Higgsfield for AI video generation, character animation, and b-roll creation

- ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers and voice cloning

- Runway for motion and visual generation

- CapCut or Premiere for editing

- Canva for thumbnails and static elements

 

If you are not already using AI tools like these in your daily workflow, this role is not for you. We are not looking for someone "willing to learn AI." We need someone who already generates AI assets as part of how they work.

 

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT:

 

Most editing jobs hand you footage and say "make it look good." Even most "editor" ad jobs hand you a script and say "make it convert." This role is different — you write the script AND make it convert. You are thinking about performance at every step:

- Why does this hook need to hit in under 2 seconds?

- Why does the b-roll need to shift at the mechanism section?

- Why does the pacing slow down when the product is introduced?

- Why does the CTA need urgency without feeling desperate?

 

If you already think like this — as a strategist and an editor at the same time — you will thrive here.

 

WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE:

 

- Direct response experience — ads that ran on cold traffic for e-commerce, DTC, or supplement brands. Not brand content. Not reels.

- The ability to write your own scripts. This is non-negotiable. You will not be handed scripts. You research the angle, write the hook and body, and build the ad from it.

- AI-native workflow — you already use Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway or equivalents daily.

- Hook psychology — you understand what makes the first 3 seconds stop the scroll and can explain why.

- Performance awareness — you know what hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and ROAS mean, and can look at metrics and identify what to change in the next ad.

- Health or supplement niche experience preferred — ads for older, health-conscious buyers. You understand this audience responds differently than a 25-year-old buying a gadget.

- Strong creative instincts — from a blank page, you know what angle to take, what to write, what b-roll to use, what voice to cast, and how to make it feel like content, not a commercial.

 

THIS ROLE IS NOT:

YouTube editing, brand/social content, podcast editing, motion graphics/logo animation, a pure execution role where you wait for scripts, or a junior learn-on-the-job position.

 

If your portfolio is YouTube videos, weddings, vlogs, or brand content — or you can only edit what someone else writes — please do not apply.

 

COMPENSATION AND DETAILS:

- Starting at $1,000 USD per month with performance-based increases as your ads prove out

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, fully remote

- Flexible schedule with daily output expected and end-of-day check-ins via WhatsApp

- Long-term position for someone who wants to own the full creative pipeline

 

HOW TO APPLY:

 

Apply only through this Google Form:
